Role Overview
 
Located in Algiers and reporting to the Global HRIS Manager, the Global HR Coordinator ensures smooth HR operations and contributes to the implementation of cross-functional HR initiatives. 
 
The role requires strong HRIS expertise, meticulous attention to detail, autonomy, and ability to manage priorities. Comfort with data analysis and operational reporting is essential.
description:
Role Overview
 
Located in Algiers and reporting to the Global HRIS Manager, the Global HR Coordinator ensures smooth HR operations and contributes to the implementation of cross-functional HR initiatives. 
 
The role requires strong HRIS expertise, meticulous attention to detail, autonomy, and ability to manage priorities. Comfort with data analysis and operational reporting is essential.

lists.content:
•  
    •  
    HRIS & Process Improvement Projects
  • Contribute to HRIS enhancement initiatives (system configuration improvements, workflow automation, integrations, data mapping exercises).
  • Support policy rollouts, internal audits, compliance initiatives, and documentation standardization.
  • Maintain project documentation, trackers, and timelines while coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Assist in deploying consistent HR processes across teams & regions and ensuring alignment of HRIS usage.
    •  
    HRIS Reporting, Dashboards & Data Insights
  • Produce monthly operational reports (e.g., headcount, attendance, attrition, absences), ensuring reliability and structured data sourcing from HRIS.
  • Build HR dashboards and metrics to support decision-making and monitor compliance.
  • Generate ad hoc HR analytics and insights, ensuring traceable methodology and clean datasets.
    •  
    Recruitment Support & ATS Management
  • Manage user roles, permissions, and profile provisioning within the ATS (Lever).
  • Support recruiting teams operationally, ensuring smooth workflow between ATS and HRIS.
  • Produce recruitment analytics and reports and ensure proper data within the ATS
    •  
    HR Administration & Systems Management
  • Own the HRIS data lifecycle: create, maintain, audit, and update freelancers records across all HR systems and internal trackers.
  • Ensure data governance, accuracy, consistency, completeness, and traceability across HRIS modules (data, org structure, compensation, attendance, etc.).
  • Track upcoming agreements expirations, follow up with relevant stakeholders, and prepare related documentation
  • Support onboarding and offboarding workflows within the HRIS, ensuring that access, documentation, and compliance requirements are executed correctly.
    •

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in HR administration or HR project management, ideally within a technology or high-growth environment.
  • Strong proficiency with HRIS and ATS 
  • Comfortable working with data, reports, and analytics.
  • Excellent organizational skills, autonomy, and attention to details
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of working in a multicultural environment.
  • Fluent in both English and French, written and spoken.
  • High level of discretion and integrity when handling confidential information.
    •

description:
À propos de Yassir

Yassir est la super application leader des services à la demande dans la région du Maghreb. Notre mission : transformer la façon dont les services du quotidien sont accessibles, grâce à une plateforme innovante et en constante évolution.

Présente dans plus de 45 villes à travers plusieurs pays — Algérie, Maroc, Tunisie, Sénégal — ainsi qu'en France et dans divers pays d’Afrique sub-saharienne, Yassir poursuit une expansion rapide sur de nouveaux marchés.

Soutenue par des investisseurs internationaux de renom comme BOND et Y Combinator (Airbnb, Stripe, Dropbox, DoorDash), l’entreprise a levé près de 200 millions de dollars, consolidant sa position d’acteur incontournable de la tech africaine.

Au-delà de la fourniture de services, notre ambition est de créer un écosystème durable, fondé sur la satisfaction utilisateur et des valeurs sociales fortes.

lists.content:
Le HORECA Acquisition Specialist a pour mission principale de développer et étendre le réseau de partenaires marchands Yassir Cash auprès du secteur HORECA (Hôtels, Restaurants, Cafés) sur l'ensemble du territoire algérien.

Intervenant comme un chasseur commercial terrain, il est responsable de l'intégralité du cycle de vente : de la prospection à la signature du contrat, jusqu'à l'activation effective du point de vente. Son objectif ultime est d'imposer Yassir Cash comme le

mode de paiement électronique incontournable chez tous les acteurs de la restauration et de l'hôtellerie en Algérie.

• Prospecter et développer un portefeuille de partenaires HORECA en identifiant les établissements à fort potentiel.

  • Présenter l'offre Yassir Cash, négocier les partenariats et conclure les ventes.

  • Assurer le processus d'onboarding des nouveaux marchands (contrats, documents administratifs et mise en place des solutions de paiement).

  • Accompagner le lancement des partenaires, former les équipes, veiller à la visibilité des supports marketing et assurer le suivi des activités via le CRM.

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented HR Administrator fluent in French and English to join our team. This role combines operational HR excellence with project coordination, ensuring smooth employee lifecycle management and supporting business growth. You will act as a reliable partner to employees and leadership, driving consistency and efficiency across HR processes.
 
Key Responsibilities
HR Administration & Systems Management
Create, maintain, and audit employee records in HRIS and internal trackers.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and compliance across HR systems.
Support onboarding and offboarding processes with precision.
Handle first-level employee queries regarding documentation, system access, and leave requests.
Reporting & Data Oversight
Produce monthly HR operational reports (headcount, attendance, absences, etc.).
Generate dashboards, analytics, and ad hoc reports as required.
Employee Lifecycle Management
Track contract expirations, follow up with stakeholders, and prepare documentation.
Manage HR administrative documents with compliance and accuracy.
Recruitment Support & ATS Management
Provide operational support to recruitment teams, including scheduling and documentation.
Ensure data integrity and organization within the ATS.
Generate recruitment reports and assist with candidate communication.
HR Project Coordination
Contribute to HR projects such as system enhancements, policy rollouts, audits, and process standardization.
Maintain project documentation, timelines, and trackers.
Support the deployment of consistent HR standards across teams and regions.
 
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in HR administration or HR project coordination.
Strong proficiency with HRIS and ATS systems.
Skilled in data management, reporting, and analytics.
Excellent organizational skills, autonomy, and attention to detail.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work in a multicultural environment.
Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.
High level of discretion and integrity in handling confidential information

description:
We are seeking an experienced an HRIS Project Manager to lead the end-to-end implementation and optimization of Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS). The successful candidate will partner with HR, IT, Payroll, Finance, and business stakeholders to deliver HR technology projects on time, within scope, and within budget while ensuring successful adoption across the organization.

This role requires a strong understanding of HR processes, HR technology, project management methodologies, change management, and stakeholder management.

lists.content:
Project Management

  • Lead end-to-end HRIS implementation projects from planning through post-go-live support.
  • Develop project plans, timelines, milestones, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Manage project scope, dependencies, risks, issues, and change requests.
  • Monitor project progress and communicate status updates to leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to quality standards.

    • HRIS Implementation

    • Gather and document business requirements from HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders.
    • Work closely with HRIS vendors and implementation partners throughout the implementation lifecycle.
    • Configure and validate HRIS processes in collaboration with functional experts.
    • Coordinate data migration, system integrations, testing (UAT), and production deployment.
    • Support process redesign and ensure alignment with HR best practices.
    • Manage post-implementation stabilization activities and continuous system improvements.

      • Stakeholder Management

      • Act as the primary point of contact between internal stakeholders and external implementation partners.
      • Facilitate workshops, project meetings, steering committee updates, and decision-making sessions.
      • Build strong relationships across HR, IT, Payroll, Finance, Legal, and leadership teams.
      • Drive stakeholder engagement and manage expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

        • Change Management & Training

        • Develop and execute change management and communication plans.
        • Coordinate end-user training and create user documentation.
        • Support business readiness activities to ensure successful system adoption.
        • Monitor adoption metrics and recommend improvements where necessary.

          • Governance & Reporting

          • Track project KPIs, budget, risks, and project health.
          • Prepare executive-level project reports and presentations.
          • Ensure compliance with internal governance processes and data privacy requirements.
          • Maintain project documentation and implementation artifacts.

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Information Systems, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of project management experience.
  • Proven experience leading at least one full-cycle HRIS implementation.
  • Strong understanding of HR processes across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, employee administration, leave management, organizational management, and performance management.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams including HR, IT, Payroll, and Finance.

  • Experience integrating HRIS platforms with Payroll, Identity Management, ATS or ERP is a strong advantage.

    Technical Skills

    • HRIS implementation and configuration
    • Project planning and scheduling
    • Data migration and validation
    • User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
    • Process mapping and business analysis
    • Risk and issue management
    • Change management
    • Reporting and dashboard creation

      • Soft Skills

      • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
      • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
      • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
      • Strong organizational and planning skills.
      • Ability to influence without direct authority.
      • High attention to detail and ownership.
      • Strong facilitation and presentation skills.

        •

lists.content:
• Build and maintain reusable SwiftUI components aligned with a design system
  • Implement UI using SwiftUI + MVVM, respecting clean architecture boundaries
  • Translate Figma designs into production-ready SwiftUI views
  • Navigate Figma files confidently (components, variants, auto-layout, styles, tokens)
  • Apply design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, states) consistently in code
  • Ensure accessibility compliance (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, contrast, focus order)
  • Support multiple screen sizes, orientations, and Dynamic Type settings
  • Collaborate with designers to refine layouts, animations, and interactions
  • Maintain high standards of code clarity, modularity, and testability
  • Review and refactor UI code for maintainability and performance

• 3–5 years of professional iOS development experience
  • Strong production experience with SwiftUISolid understanding of MVVM architecture and clean architecture principles
  • Proven ability to build modular, reusable UI components
  • Strong knowledge of iOS accessibility standards and best practices
  • Practical experience working with Figma design files, including: Components and variants, Design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, states), Auto-layout and responsive behavior.
  • Experience supporting multiple device sizes and orientations
  • High attention to detail in UI behavior, layout precision, and animations
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-structured Swift code

• UI craftsmanship and consistency
  • Strong alignment between design and implementation
  • Accessibility as a non-negotiable requirement
  • Clean architecture and long-term maintainability
  • Clear communication with designers and engineers
  • Ownership of UI quality from design to delivery

It currently operates in 45 cities across Algeria, Morocco and Tunisia with recent expansions into France, Canada and Sub-Saharan Africa. It is backed (~$200M in funding) by VCs from Silicon Valley, Europe and other parts of the world.  
We offer on-demand services such as ride-hailing and last-mile delivery. Building on this infrastructure, we are now introducing financial services to help our users pay, save and borrow digitally. 
Helping usher the continent into a digital economy era. We’re not just about serving people - we’re about creating a marketplace to bring people what they need while infusing social values.
descriptionBody:
About the Role:
 
We are looking for an experienced iOS Developer (3–5 years) with deep SwiftUI expertise to focus on building robust, reusable UI components within a clean, MVVM-based architecture. This role is UI-focused and requires strong collaboration with design, a solid understanding of Figma files and design systems, and a high standard for accessibility and clean code.
 
You will be working primarily on the presentation layer, ensuring UI components are scalable, accessible, and aligned with design tokens and system guidelines.

descriptionPlain:
Description du poste
Le pilote en informatique a pour mission d’assurer le pilotage opérationnel des activités informatiques de son unité (Hypermarché), en veillant à la disponibilité, à la performance et à la sécurité des outils et services informatiques. Il coordonne les actions techniques, suit les incidents, accompagne les utilisateurs et contribue à la continuité ainsi qu’à l’amélioration du système d’information.
 
Missions Principales
1. Pilotage opérationnel
-Assurer le suivi quotidien de l’activité informatique.
-Coordonner les interventions des équipes internes et des prestataires externes.
-Suivre les incidents, demandes de support et actions correctives.
-Contrôler le respect des délais d’intervention et des niveaux de service.
2. Suivi de l’exploitation informatique
-Veiller au bon fonctionnement des équipements, applications, réseaux et systèmes.
-Participer à la supervision de l’infrastructure informatique.
-Suivre les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective.
-Contribuer à la continuité de service des outils informatiques.
3. Assistance et coordination
-Servir d’interface entre les utilisateurs, les équipes techniques et les prestataires.
-Recueillir, qualifier et prioriser les besoins ou anomalies signalés.
-Assurer un suivi régulier de la résolution des incidents.
-Informer les utilisateurs sur l’état d’avancement des demandes.
4. Reporting et amélioration continue
-Produire les tableaux de bord et indicateurs de suivi d’activité.
-Analyser les dysfonctionnements récurrents et proposer des actions d’amélioration.
-Participer à l’optimisation des procédures et des méthodes de travail.
-Rédiger et mettre à jour la documentation technique et fonctionnelle.
5. Sécurité et conformité
-Veiller à l’application des procédures internes en matière de sécurité informatique.
-Participer au contrôle des accès, habilitations et bonnes pratiques d’utilisation.
-Contribuer à la conformité des outils et processus IT avec les exigences de l’entreprise.

lists.content:
• Build robust and scalable software in Java (Spring, Spring boot & hibernate)
  • Design and create (micro)services and system architecture for projects, and contribute and provide feedback to other team members.
  • Help improve existing code quality through writing unit tests, automation and performing code reviews.
  • Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas to our technology, algorithms and products.
  • Work with the engineering and design teams to understand end-user requirements, formulate use cases, and then translate that into a pragmatic and effective technical solution.
  • Dive into difficult problems and successfully deliver results on schedule.

• BSc/MSc in Engineering, Computer Science or relevant field
  • At least 2 years of experience in a similar role
  • Solid OOP and software design knowledge – you should know how to create software that is extensible, reusable and meets desired architectural objectives.

• Language: Java.
  • Database: MongoDB or other.
  • Framework: Spring boot and hibernate. 
  • Web architecture: Rest and restful APIs, micro-services
  • TDD
  • Experience with Front end development and frameworks like Vue or React
  • Nice to have technical skills (Strongly advised for senior profiles):
  • Containers: Docker, kubernetes
  • Caching, Redis server
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize, self-start, contribute under pressure and meet tight deadlines
  • Highly organized, creative and critical thinker
  • Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment
  • Experience in a rapidly growing company in the mobility, on-demand  or fin-tech space is a plus

descriptionPlain:
À propos de Yassir :
 
Yassir est la super application leader dans le domaine des services à la demande, opérant de manière prédominante dans la région du Maghreb. Yassir a pour mission de révolutionner la manière dont les services quotidiens sont accessibles.
Actuellement implantée dans plus de 45 villes à travers plusieurs pays tels que l'Algérie, le Maroc, la Tunisie et le Sénégal, notre présence s'étend aussi sur d'autres pays tels que la France et l'Afrique sub-saharienne.
Fortement soutenue par des investisseurs de renommée mondiale tels que BOND et Y Combinator, pionniers d'entreprises telles qu'Airbnb, Stripe, Dropbox, et Doordash, Yassir a réussi à faire de nombreuses levées de fonds équivalentes à presque 200 millions $.
Au-delà de la simple prestation de services, notre vision est de créer un marché dynamique visant à satisfaire les besoins de nos utilisateurs tout en insufflant des valeurs sociales fondamentales.

lists.content:
• Participer à l’exécution des plans de mise sur le marché (Go-To-Market) des services financiers de Yassir.

  • Contribuer à la préparation des analyses de marché, benchmarks concurrentiels et segmentations clients.

  • Coordonner avec les équipes Performance Marketing, Growth et Brand pour le déploiement des campagnes marketing.

  • Participer aux études de marché et à la collecte d’insights clients (sondages, retours terrain, analyses de base).

  • Contribuer à la création et à la mise à jour des messages produits, présentations et supports marketing.

  • Suivre et reporter les principaux KPIs du Product Marketing afin de contribuer à l’optimisation des campagnes.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes Sales et Business Development pour définir les besoins et aligner les priorités ainsi que les délais.

    •

• Minimum 2 ans d’expérience en marketing ou en product marketing, idéalement acquise dans le secteur des télécommunications ou bancaire.

  • Fort intérêt pour la fintech et les produits digitaux.

  • Esprit analytique avec une connaissance de base en analyse de données (Excel / Google Sheets ; la maîtrise d’autres outils marketing est un plus).

  • Bonnes compétences en communication et en rédaction (arabe et français ; l’anglais est un atout).

  • Capacité à travailler de manière transverse et à gérer plusieurs tâches simultanément.

  • Personne proactive, curieuse et motivée par l’apprentissage.

descriptionPlain:
About Kawarizmi
We don’t just monetize traffic; we turn it into Cultural Capital.
Kawarizmi is the leading ''Culture-First'' monetization partner dedicated to the Maghreb and African Diaspora. In a market where generalist platforms see ''exotic readers'' and undervalue specific audiences, we see high-value targets. We act as the bridge between premium publishers and digital-exclusive advertisers (Banks, Airlines, Telcos) targeting the region.
Your Job
Your core mission is to drive Kawarizmi's growth in the African and Middle Eastern markets.
You will be the ''Hunter'' acquiring small to medium-sized web publishers and creators, but also the ''Farmer'' helping them realize the true value of their audience through strategic advisory.
1. Drive Publisher Acquisition (The Hunter)
Target Strategically: Map the digital landscape to identify high-potential web publishers and creators in the Maghreb and West Africa.
Outreach & Pitch: Manage the full sales cycle from cold outreach to closing. You will pitch our ''first look'' ; opportunity and explain why our RPM beats the competition.
Build Trust: Effectively demonstrate our value proposition to publishers who are tired of being undervalued by Google & consort.
2. Master the Tech (The Operator)
Optimization: You aren't just selling; you understand the product. You will use tools like Google Ad Manager (GAM) to help onboard partners, ensuring their ad units and formats are optimized for our demand.
Master the Metrics: You will dive deep into the data. You are responsible for monitoring and optimizing key performance indicators RPM (Revenue Per Mille): Your north star. You will implement strategies to increase the overall revenue per 1,000 page views
Seamless Handover: Work closely with technical teams to ensure scripts and line items are implemented correctly and tags are live within our promised 48-hour window.
3. Nurture & Upsell (The Advisor)
Be the Strategic Partner: You are not just a vendor; you are their monetization consultant. You will manage the day-to-day relationship, ensuring publisher satisfaction and retention.
Yield Advisory: Analyze publisher inventory to recommend layout changes, density improvements, or viewability hacks that increase their revenue without hurting UX.
Upsell Strategy: Identify opportunities to expand the partnership. This includes convincing publishers to adopt high-impact formats (Interstitials, Video), implementing Header Bidding, or granting Kawarizmi exclusive access to premium inventory.
4. Analyze & Grow (The Strategist)
Monitor Performance: Track campaign outcomes and publisher yield (RPM). Use data to spot trends in African traffic and suggest optimizations. Be the Voice of the Market: Provide actionable feedback from the field to help us refine our commercial strategy for the region.

3. Nurture & Upsell (The Advisor)
  • Be the Strategic Partner: You are not just a vendor; you are their monetization consultant. You will manage the day-to-day relationship, ensuring publisher satisfaction and retention.
  • Yield Advisory: Analyze publisher inventory to recommend layout changes, density improvements, or viewability hacks that increase their revenue without hurting UX.
  • Upsell Strategy: Identify opportunities to expand the partnership. This includes convincing publishers to adopt high-impact formats (Interstitials, Video), implementing Header Bidding, or granting Kawarizmi exclusive access to premium inventory.
4. Analyze & Grow (The Strategist)
  • Monitor Performance: Track campaign outcomes and publisher yield (RPM). Use data to spot trends in African traffic and suggest optimizations. Be the Voice of the Market: Provide actionable feedback from the field to help us refine our commercial strategy for the region.
  • Your Profile
  • Experience: 1-3 years of experience in AdTech, Digital Publishing, or B2B Sales. You have a track record of "hunting" and closing deals, but you also know how to maintain a client portfolio.
  • Ad Ops Fundamentals: Practical experience with Google Ad Manager (GAM) or SSPs is a plus. You must possess strong theoretical knowledge of the ad-tech stack: you know what a Line Item, a Creative, and a Key-Value pair are, and you understand how to track Publisher KPIs.
  • Language: Native/Fluent French and professional English. Arabic is a strong plus.
  • Mindset: You have a ''Builder'' mentality. You are comfortable with cold calling, persistent follow-ups, and negotiation.
  • Analytical: You are comfortable with Excel and data. You don't guess; you verify. Your Mindset to Share Our Adventure
  • Impact Driven: You want to move things forward. Hearing ''we've always done it this way'' makes you uncomfortable. You believe progress comes from questioning the status quo.
  • Pragmatic Solver: You solve problems analytically. You understand the 80/20 (Pareto) principle and focus on high-impact actions.
  • Agile: You are looking for a fast-moving environment (Startup/Scale-up pace) where agility is an asset, not a buzzword.
  • Curious Learner: You have the humility to listen, learn, and challenge yourself to improve daily.
  • Benefits & Work Environment :
  • Dynamic Culture: We embrace a flexible environment. We care about output, not hours in a chair.
  • Talent Growth: We provide robust career development. You will learn the ins and outs of Programmatic Advertising, Header Bidding, and Yield Management from experts.
  • Competitive Package: A salary that respects your competence, plus a commission structure based on the publisher's success.
  • Tech-Savvy Ecosystem: We use the latest tools (Gemini Pro, Supermetrics, Zoho Pro…) to keep operations seamless. No red tape, just results.
  • Close-Knit Team: Be part of a united team where collaboration and mutual support drive our collective success
 
Ready to take the wheel? Apply now and help us build the future of African digital media.

description:
In 2026, writing code is no longer the primary bottleneck; managing its complexity and ensuring- its reliability is. We are building a highly resilient software ecosystem with a very lean internal team.
To achieve massive scale without the overhead of a large internal engineering department, we rely heavily on an AI-first development paradigm and external development partners (currently a specialized advertising tech agency, with plans to integrate ad-hoc remote talent).
We operate on a philosophy inspired by the best large-scale Open Source projects. This does not mean our code is public, but rather that we adopt their governance: asynchronous communication, exhaustive written documentation, explicit rules, and uncompromising quality
gates.

This is the only way to seamlessly integrate remote humans and AI agents without creating technical debt.

The Role


While you possess deep, highly advanced technical capabilities and can dive into the codebase when critical, this role is not about typing code all day. You will operate with a scope closer to a VP of Engineering. Your primary objective is to guarantee the quality, reliability, and predictability of the software evolution (Outcomes over Outputs).
You will architect the systems, define the tasks, orchestrate the execution by AI and external developers, and act as the ultimate gatekeeper for quality.
1. Delivery Orchestration & External Team Management
● Agency & Remote Coordination: You will manage the technical delivery of an external dev agency (specialized in ad-tech) and structure the project to allow the frictionless onboarding of sporadic, ad-hoc freelance talent in the future.
● Flawless Specification: Translate business needs into highly explicit, self-sufficient technical issues. Your specifications must be clear enough that an external developer or an AI agent can execute them without needing a synchronous meeting.
● System Architecture & Evolution: Oversee the high-level architecture across our stack (GCP, Rust, React, Postgres, Stream processing). You are the guarantor of scalability and system integrity. Your direct manager will retain responsibility for strategy, guidance, architecture design and high-level technical decisions.
2. The AI-First Paradigm
● AI as the Primary Coder: We expect AI to write the majority of the code. You must be 100% proficient in this new development lifecycle. You are the editor; the AI is the writer.
● Agentic Workflows: We are preparing setups utilizing advanced conversational and agentic CLI tools (e.g., Claude Code, custom tools/skills). You will drive the adoption and structuring of these workflows.
● CI/CD Innovation: While AI is heavily used in code generation, integrating AI into our CI/CD pipelines (for automated reviews, security checks, etc.) is an open frontier.

We expect you to study and propose implementations to automate our quality gates further.
3. Strict Governance & Quality Gates
● Open Source Governance Model: You will enforce a rigid, predictable workflow. Everything must be documented. If it is not written down, it does not exist.
● Documentation as a Gateway: Maintain rigorous Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). You can leverage AI to write the documentation, but you are responsible for 100% human validation before it becomes the single source of truth.
● Uncompromising Code Reviews: Enforce strict quality gates at every passage point.
You ensure that whether the code was written by a senior agency developer or an LLM, it meets our exacting standards for performance, security, and maintainability.

The Tech Stack


● Languages & Frameworks: Rust (Core/Backend), React (Frontend)
● Data & Processing: PostgreSQL, Stream Processing, Advanced Analytics
● Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

Profile & Requirements


We are looking for a highly autonomous, systems-oriented engineering leader who thrives in a fast-paced, high-quality, lean environment. This role is not suited for individuals who primarily enjoy hands-on coding within a large internal team structure.

Essential Experience

● Senior Engineering Leadership: 7+ years of progressive experience in software development, with at least 3 years in a lead or principal role managing system architecture and delivery of complex, highly available, and scalable systems.
● Architecture & Systems Design: Proven experience in designing, deploying, and maintaining cloud-native applications on a major cloud provider (GCP experience preferred).
●Deep understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, and performance optimization.
● Rust Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Rust in a production environment or open-source project is a strong advantage. Alternatively, exceptional depth in a similar compiled systems language (e.g., Go, C++) combined with a strong willingness to master Rust immediately.
● External Orchestration: Demonstrated ability to manage and lead technical delivery
across external teams (agencies, freelancers, contractors) while maintaining
accountability and quality control.
● Governance & Documentation: A strong belief in and history of enforcing rigorous engineering practices, including comprehensive documentation (ADRs, RFCs) and disciplined code review processes.

Core Competencies & Mindset

● Technical Orchestration: The ability to decompose ambiguous business goals into
ultra-clear, executable technical specifications for non-internal teams and AI agents.
● AI Development Lifecycle: Deep comfort and proficiency in integrating advanced LLMs
and agentic tools into the development workflow (e.g., prompt engineering for code
generation, validating AI-produced code).
● Uncompromising Quality: A maniacal focus on the non-functional requirements:security, performance, reliability, and maintainability. Must be the ultimate gatekeeper for
quality.
 
● Remote & Asynchronous Communication: Exceptional written communication skills are mandatory. 
● Must be able to operate effectively in a globally distributed,
asynchronous environment (Paris timezone +/- 3h).

descriptionPlain:
As a marketing data analyst at Yassir, working in the Data and AI team, you will have the opportunity to make significant contributions to Yassir's marketing strategies, targeting efforts, and customer engagement initiatives. You will leverage advanced analytics to optimize marketing campaigns, understand audience behavior, and enhance the overall marketing performance, ultimately driving growth and success across Yassir's services in 45 cities across 7 countries (Algeria, Tunisia, Morocco, Senegal, South Africa, and France).
 
Responsibilities:
Collaborate with marketing teams to analyze marketing performance metrics, including attribution, audience targeting effectiveness, campaign ROI, and user engagement metrics.
Utilize data analysis skills, along with a deep understanding of marketing principles, to identify opportunities for improving marketing strategies and tactics.
Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Research, and other teams to integrate marketing data into overall business strategy and product development processes.
Serve as a data ambassador, promoting a data-driven marketing culture within the organization.
Influence marketing strategy and execution by providing data-driven insights and recommendations to key stakeholders.
Partner with Engineering to ensure the collection of relevant data for informed decision-making and optimization of marketing efforts.
Develop and implement hypotheses for optimizing marketing performance, employing rigorous analytical approaches and methodologies.
Communicate insights and recommendations effectively through data-driven storytelling, influencing stakeholders to make data-informed decisions.
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
A minimum experience of 5 years in analytics in an app marketing environment, including a track record of leveraging attribution tools and analytics to define marketing strategies and of defining tracking plans for marketing campaigns. 
Experience with data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python), and/or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R)
Language skills: French and English (fluent), Arabic is an advantage. 
Benefits:

descriptionPlain:
Yassir is the leading super App in the Maghreb region set to changing the way daily services are provided. It currently operates in 45 cities across Algeria, Morocco and Tunisia with recent expansions into France, Canada and Sub-Saharan Africa. It is backed (~$200M in funding) by VCs from Silicon Valley, Europe and other parts of the world.  
We offer on-demand services such as ride-hailing and last-mile delivery. Building on this infrastructure, we are now introducing financial services to help our users pay, save and borrow digitally. 
Helping usher the continent into a digital economy era. We’re not just about serving people - we’re about creating a marketplace to bring people what they need while infusing social values.


About the Role:
 
We’re looking for a Mid-Senior Frontend Engineer to join our SEFAR Design System team. SEFAR is Yassir’s internal component library that powers our web applications with reusable, accessible, and well-documented React components. 
You’ll work closely with our UI/UX team to transform Figma designs into production-ready code, maintain our design token system, and ensure our components meet the highest standards of quality, accessibility, and performance.

You’ll work closely with our UI/UX team to transform Figma designs into production-ready code, maintain our design token system, and ensure our components meet the highest standards of quality, accessibility, and performance.

lists.content:
•   Component Development & Maintenance:
    •  
  •  Build, maintain, and evolve React components following our established patterns (CVA variants, forwardRef, composition)  
  • Translate Figma designs into pixel-perfect, accessible, and performant components  
  • Implement and maintain design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, shadows)  
  • Create compound components using Radix UI primitives  
    •  
  • Quality Assurance:         
    •  
  • Write comprehensive unit tests using Jest and React Testing Library 
  • Ensure WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance across all components 
  • Support RTL layouts for Arabic language markets  
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain high code quality standards 
    •  
  •  Documentation:
    •  
  •  Create and maintain Storybook stories with interactive controls and proper documentation
  • Keep component documentation up-to-date with design changes  
  • Work with Figma Code Connect to link components to design files  
    •  
  • Collaboration:  
    •  
  • Partner with UI/UX designers to ensure design feasibility and optimal implementation  
  • Support product teams consuming the component library  
  • Contribute to design system governance and component API decisions

•   Must Have:
  • 4+ years of professional frontend development experience
  • Expert-level React with TypeScript (hooks, context, refs, composition patterns)
  • Strong proficiency with Tailwind CSS and utility-first styling
  • Experience building or maintaining component libraries/design systems- Solid understanding of web accessibility (ARIA, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation)
  • Proficiency with testing (Jest, React Testing Library, or similar)
  • Experience with Storybook for component documentation
  • Understanding of design tokens and design-to-code workflows
  • Strong Git proficiency and experience with PR-based workflows
  • Ability to effectively use AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, etc.) to accelerate development while maintaining code quality 
    •  
  • Nice to Have:
  • Experience with Radix UI or similar headless UI libraries
  • Familiarity with class-variance-authority (CVA) or similar variant management
  • Experience with Vite and modern build tooling 
  • Understanding of bundle optimization and tree-shaking- Experience with Figma or design tools from a developer perspective- Prior experience supporting RTL languages (Arabic, Hebrew)
  • Experience publishing packages to npm/GitHub Packages

lists.content: • Yassir is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Scientist, of any level, to join our Artificial Intelligence (AI) team and contribute to some of our key projects, such as Dynamic Pricing and Trip Dispatching. As a Data Scientist, you will play a crucial role in analyzing and modelling data to optimize our Machine Learning (ML) systems. Your expertise in both predictive modelling and software development will be essential in driving our solutions and providing value to Yassir. This is a very exciting opportunity, tackling some of Yassir’s most critical problems.

• The AI team is part of Yassir’s central Data & AI domain, which is responsible for all data related activities in the organization - from Data Engineering, Data Platform management and Data Analytics all the way to AI solutions and MLOps infrastructure development. We are a global team of Data and AI / ML experts, encompassing diverse backgrounds and skills. We strive to build state-of-the-art Data and ML infrastructure and solutions, and ultimately a Data Culture supported by responsible and democratized data access, data-driven decision making and automation. We push the envelope of what’s feasible, we challenge each other, we support each other, and we take great pride in our work. Most of all we are value-driven to create impact from our data solutions. If you have an inherent curiosity about the fields Data and AI, a relevant background and an internal zeal and drive to contribute, please come join us!

• Become an expert point of contact and thought leader on your scope by mastering the details and principles pertaining to it.
  • Some key areas we have to focus include: optimizing our Pricing capabilities, such as Dynamic / Surge Pricing, Discounts / Commissioning Optimization and Personalized Pricing, optimizing our Dispatching capabilities, optimizing our Fraud Detection / Revenue Leakage Prevention capabilities, optimizing our Recommendations / Personalization capabilities, amongst others.
  • Identify and propose ML opportunities related to your scope and beyond
  • Support with requirements definition and prioritization of ML projects
  • Collaborate with cross-functional Engineering and Product teams
  • Champion Data Quality as a critical input component to all ML solutions and Analytics
  • Conduct Exploratory Data Analysis and subsequent Feature Selection / Engineering
  • Utilize Statistical and ML techniques, as appropriate, for model training
  • Validate and tune ML models
  • Visualize analysis / modelling results focusing on meaningful, actionable metrics and insights
  • Deploy and test ML applications using our MLOps infrastructureMonitor ML models on their technical performance, business impact and underlying data / concept drift
  • Explain technical solutions in a business-friendly manner, supporting Product teams in their communications and reporting
  • Maintain and improve technical documentation of delivered solutions
  • Support the Data & AI domain in developing its technical capabilities, improving its ways of working and collaboration with other dependent teams
  • Champion Data Culture, proactively share knowledge across teams, and participate and drive team building activities

• Solid Mathematical / Statistical / Machine Learning as well as Software Development technical skills - supported by a Masters degree or above in a relevant quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Operational Research, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics
  • Comfortable in efficient, production quality Python and SQL coding at a professional setting with at least 2 years of industry experience (more years of experience would be required for more Senior roles)
  • Comfortable with key software engineering concepts, such as code / memory profiling, code optimization, scalability, code / QA testing, cost optimization and associated best practices.
  • Comfortable with key Statistical concepts, such as statistical testing and causal analysis
  • Analytical thinking and problem solving skills
  • Engineering mindset focused towards delivering robust applied data science solutions
  • Visualization skills, including experience with common Python ecosystem libraries and/or Analytics / BI tooling
  • Familiarity and prior use of Cloud solutions and their data / ML services - at Yassir we use Google Cloud Platform (GCP), experience with which is highly preferred
  • Mastering of the end-to-end (ML) model development lifecycle
  • Excellent communication skills, including presentation and oral / written communication (clear articulation, concise documentation) in professional English
  • Positive attitude and resilience
  • Strong interpersonal skills focused on peer support, empathy, active listening, team building and stakeholder relationships building
  • Internal drive, self-motivation and ability to work independently including own effective project management

• Experience with On-demand, Mobility or Financial Services companies
  • Experience working on ML features for Digital Products (apps, websites)
  • Experience with one or more from: Pricing / Economics related projects and/or modelling techniques (we welcome Economics / Econometrics backgrounds and experience), Fraud Detection related projects, Dispatching related projects, Personalization related projects
    •  
    Join the ride!

lists.content:
• Build a centralized data lake on GCP data services by integrating diverse data sources throughout the enterprise.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize Spark-powered batch and streaming data processing pipelines. Leverage GCP data services for complex data engineering tasks and ensure smooth integration with other platform components.
  • Design and implement data validation and quality checks to ensure accuracy, completeness and consistency across our data workflows.
  • Work closely with the AI / ML team to enable AI use cases and in particular address data needs for Machine Learning model development and monitoring.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Data Analysts and other business users from Operations, Marketing and Commercial departments, to extract valuable insights and enable data-driven decision making.
  • Collaborate with the Product teams to design, implement, and maintain the data models for analytical use cases.
  • Engage in technology exploration and research, the development of PoC’s, conducting deep investigations.
  • Design and manage ETL/ELT processes, ensuring data integrity, availability, and performance.
  • Troubleshoot data issues and conduct root cause analysis when reporting data is in question.
  • Work on Gen AI related initiatives aligned with the company goals.

• PySpark - Batch and Streaming
  • GCP - Dataproc, Dataflow, DataStream, Dataplex, Pub/Sub, BigQuery and Cloud Storage
  • NoSQL (preferably MongoDB)
  • Programming languages: Scala/Python
  • Great Expectation, or similar DQ framework
  • Familiarity with workflow management tools like: Airflow, Prefect or Luigi
  • Understanding of Data Governance, Data Warehousing and Data Modelling
  • Good SQL knowledge

• Able to communicate effectively, distill technical knowledge into digestible messages in a succinct / visual way
  • Proactively identify and contribute with team development initiatives, and supporting junior members

• Infrastructure-as-Code, preferably Terraform
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • Looker
  • AI / ML engineering knowledge
  • Lineage, or relevant tools e.g. Atlan
  • DBT

lists.content:
• Design and build mobile applications using iOS (swiftUI) platform.
  • Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications
  • Collaborate with a team to define, design, and ship new features
  • Identify and correct bottlenecks and fix bugs
  • Help maintain code quality, organization, and automatization
  • Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas to our technology, algorithms and products.
  • Work with the engineering and design teams to understand end-user requirements, formulate use cases, and then translate that into a pragmatic and effective technical solution
  • Dive into difficult problems and successfully deliver results on schedule

• Must have technical skills with at least 2 years of experience
  • Language: iOS (swift) native
  • Familiarity with cloud message APIs and push notification
  • Web architecture: Rest and restful APIs, micro-services
  • Version control: GIT
  • Nice to have technical skills (Strongly advised)
  • Containers: Docker, kubernetes
  • Caching, Redis server
  • Scaling, Web load balancing

descriptionPlain:
À propos de Yassir :
 
Yassir est la super application leader dans le domaine des services à la demande, opérant de manière prédominante dans la région du Maghreb. Yassir a pour mission de révolutionner la manière dont les services quotidiens sont accessibles.
Actuellement implantée dans plus de 45 villes à travers plusieurs pays tels que l'Algérie, le Maroc, la Tunisie et le Sénégal, notre présence s'étend aussi sur d'autres pays tels que la France et l'Afrique sub-saharienne.
Fortement soutenue par des investisseurs de renommée mondiale tels que BOND et Y Combinator, pionniers d'entreprises telles qu'Airbnb, Stripe, Dropbox, et Doordash, Yassir a réussi à faire de nombreuses levées de fonds équivalentes à presque 200 millions $.
Au-delà de la simple prestation de services, notre vision est de créer un marché dynamique visant à satisfaire les besoins de nos utilisateurs tout en insufflant des valeurs sociales fondamentales.
 
Missions :
Gérer et assurer le suivi des réclamations utilisateurs.
Réaliser les reportings réguliers (événementiels et mensuels).
Apporter des réponses adaptées aux utilisateurs concernant leurs questions, réclamations et commentaires.
Identifier et signaler les contenus inappropriés ou sensibles.
Escalader les incidents ou comportements inhabituels aux équipes concernées.
Assurer la surveillance et la modération des commentaires et messages sur les réseaux sociaux (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, etc.).
Profil :
Diplôme en communication, marketing ou langues étrangères.
Excellentes compétences en communication, sens de l’organisation et esprit d’équipe.
Bonne maîtrise des réseaux sociaux.
Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’arabe à l’écrit.

lists.content:
• Renforcer l’équipe créative pour la conception et la production de visuels et animations publicitaires performants, en intégrant les dernières innovations en matière d’IA générative (image, vidéo, animation).
  • Le ou la candidat(e) travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les Creative Strategists et l’équipe média pour transformer les concepts publicitaires en créations impactantes, déclinées sur différents formats (Display, Social, DOOH, Vidéo…).

• 1. Conception & Production Créative
  • Création de bannières animées HTML5, vidéos courtes et visuels statiques optimisés pour le programmatique et les réseaux sociaux.
  • Intégration et animation d’éléments graphiques (images, typographies, icônes, vidéos) en respectant les guidelines des marques.
  • Utilisation des outils IA (MidJourney, DALL·E, Runway, Stable Diffusion…) pour générer ou enrichir des assets créatifs.
  • Mise en place de workflows créatifs hybrides (design traditionnel + génération IA) pour accélérer la production.
  • 2. Collaboration avec l’équipe créative et média
  • Travailler de concert avec les Creative Strategists pour décliner des concepts en livrables opérationnels.
  • Adapter les créations aux contraintes techniques des plateformes (DV360, Meta, TikTok, Google Ads…).
  • Fournir des fichiers sources organisés et optimisés (Photoshop, After Effects, Figma, etc.)
  • 3. Optimisation & Performance Créative
  •  A/B testing visuel : conception de variantes pour mesurer l’impact sur la performance (CTR, conversion, engagement).
  • Veille et intégration des tendances créatives (motion design, formats innovants, IA générative).
  • Préparation de gabarits réutilisables pour accélérer la mise en production des futures campagnes.
  • 4. Gestion technique des livrables
  • Respect des contraintes de poids, résolution et compatibilité pour diffusion programmatique.
  •  Préparation de packages HTML5 complets, vidéos optimisées et exports multi-formats.
  • Gestion rigoureuse des assets sur notre DAM (Digital Asset Management).

• Expérience en graphisme digital et motion design, idéalement dans un environnement publicitaire ou média.
  • Maîtrise des outils Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects), Figma et Google Web Designer.
  • Connaissance et pratique des outils d’IA générative image/vidéo (MidJourney, Runway, DALL·E, Stable Diffusion…).
  •  Compréhension des contraintes techniques des campagnes programmatiques et social ads.
  •  Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle, sens du détail et réactivité.
  • Bonne communication écrite et orale (FR/EN), esprit collaboratif.
    •

• L’occasion rare de changer le monde qui t’entoure de telle sorte qu’il utilise ton produit.
  • Nous ne sommes pas juste une app, nous insufflons des valeurs sociales et réinventons la façon dont les services sont fournis dans notre région,
  • Des collègues motivés dans un environnement de travail très convivial,
  • Participation au lancement de nouveaux projets innovants.

• Rémunération compétitive.
  • Complémentaire santé.
  • Formation continue.

lists.content: En tant que ‘Operational Marketing Manager’, vous êtes le responsable de la croissance de notre marque KooL en Tunisie. Votre mission est de faire de notre application le réflexe quotidien des Tunisiens pour commander à manger et de maximiser la "Lifetime Value" de chaque utilisateur à travers des campagnes percutantes et une stratégie de marque forte.

1. Stratégie de Croissance, Acquisition et rétention :

  • Concevoir et exécuter des campagnes d'acquisition (Digitales & Offline) pour booster le nombre de téléchargements et de first orders.

  • Gérer les budgets publicitaires sur les leviers clés : Offline et Online

  • Driver la stratégie CRM et SMSing pour améliorer la rétention et réduire le churn.

  • Collaborer avec l’équipe performance pour atteindre les objectifs définis. 

    • 3. Marketing Local & Partenariats

  • Collaborer avec l'équipe sales pour mettre en avant les "Key Accounts" (grandes chaînes de fast-food, local heroes).

  • Négocier et gérer des partenariats stratégiques (partenaires, opérateurs, influenceurs).

    • 4. Analyse de Données

  • Suivre quotidiennement les KPIs : CAC, GMV , Taux de conversion, AOV et Fréquence de commande.

  • Produire des rapports hebdomadaires de performance et des rapports mensuels sur les tendances de consommation..

• Expérience :entre 3 et 5 ans en marketing digital ou performance marketing idéalement dans l'e-commerce ou dans une startup de services.

  • Compétences Techniques :

  • Maîtrise des outils analytiques.

  • Compréhensions du funnel d’acquisition 

  • Compréhension de la gestion des Ads principalement sur Google et Meta

  • Excellente capacité de rédaction en Français et en Anglais

  • Soft Skills :

  • Esprit "Data-Driven" : Vous ne prenez pas de décision sans chiffres.

  • Réactivité : Le secteur de la livraison change d'heure en heure (météo, rush du soir).

  • Créativité : Capacité à créer des concepts qui appuieront les besoins du business.

• Rémunération compétitive et bonus sur la performance.
  • Complémentaire santé suite à la confirmation du profil.
  • Formation continue.

lists.content:
Role Summary

 Executes day-to-day pricing analysis, monitors live pricing performance, and supports the design and rollout of pricing rules across cities and service tiers. Works closely with Senior Specialists to build analytical foundations and develop pricing recommendations from data.

Core Responsibilities

 

•       Monitor real-time pricing health dashboards and flag anomalies

•       Run recurring pricing performance reports by city and zone

•       Support A/B test setup, tracking, and preliminary result analysis

•       Maintain pricing configuration tables and parameter documentation

•       Investigate trip fare disputes and surface root-cause patterns

•       Compile competitive fare snapshots across target markets, daily , weekly and monthly

•       Assist with onboarding pricing rules for new city launches

 Required Skills

 

  • Excel / Google Sheets 

  • BI Dashboards (Looker / DS) 

  • Basic Statistical Analysis  

  •  Attention to Data Detail    

  • Reporting    

    • Qualifications

     

    •       1–2 years in analytics, pricing, or revenue operations

    •       Degree in Economics, Business Analytics, Mathematics, or equivalent

    •       Familiarity with marketplace or platform business models

    •       Comfortable working in a fast-paced, data-driven environment

The role of a Product and Quality Specialist is pivotal in ensuring that the products manufactured and delivered meet the highest standards of quality and align with customer expectations. lists.content:
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to establish and execute robust quality control procedures. This involves defining quality checkpoints, conducting inspections, and implementing corrective measures to maintain product integrity.
  • Work closely with product development teams to embed quality considerations at every stage of the product lifecycle. By integrating quality principles early in the design phase, potential issues can be identified and addressed proactively, ensuring that the final product meets quality standards.
  • Perform various tests and audits throughout the manufacturing process to verify compliance with quality specifications. This includes conducting product inspections, analyzing samples, and utilizing testing equipment to assess product performance and reliability.
  • Analyze quality data, including customer feedback and defect reports, to identify trends and areas for improvement. Utilize this information to implement corrective actions and drive continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing product quality and customer satisfaction.
  • Stay abreast of industry quality standards, regulations, and best practices. Ensure that all products meet regulatory requirements and adhere to relevant quality standards, certifications, and compliance frameworks.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering, computer science, management, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
  • A proactive mindset with a commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
  • Previous experience or coursework in quality assurance, product development, or manufacturing processes is advantageous.

ABOUT THE ROLE
 
We are in search of a talented and motivated individual to join our team and start working on all sorts of interesting products.
 
‍As a Product designer at Yassir, you will be responsible for driving product design initiatives from inception through execution. In this role, you will collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, analysts, and other cross-functional team members within the organization to ensure that our products amaze and delight our users.
 
We are looking for an experienced product designer to contribute to the effort in revamping our service. At Yassir, we put our users and data first. So we need Product Designers with smart UI/UX skills who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that make the life of our people easier by the day. In this role, you will work cross-functionally to design and guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds and designing the product workflow from beginning to end.

• Be responsible for creating end-to-end experiences, from start to finish.
  • Partner up with Product Managers to define design solutions.
  • Create and deliver high-quality user interfaces that help improve the overall design language of our products.
  • Have a 360º view of the area you're working on and the business in general.
  • Collaborate, assist and review junior designers.
  • Lead and participate in brainstorming sessions.
  • Present design projects to stakeholders and gather feedback.
  • Develop exhaustive design handoffs, and follow design implementations with developers.
  • Conduct design and usability tests.
  • Actively build and maintain internal design system.

  • Complete mastery of design principles.
  • Strong knowledge of product development process.
  • Always up to date with design industry news and best practices.
  • Large knowledge of design patterns.
  • Great written and verbal communication skills.
  • Team player, you enjoy working in teams and sharing your experience and knowledge with others.
  • Ability and willingness to learn and develop strong design leadership skills.
  • Experience working and building Design Systems.
  • A computer science graduate, relevant degree, or equivalent.
  • Experience in a rapidly growing company in the food delivery or on-demand service space is a plus.

• 🚀 Perfect timing with renowned investors to build something great
  • 🎯Outstanding mentors who will support you in your growth
  • 💸 Attractive salary and you even get a stake in the company
  • 📈 Extremely steep learning curve with own responsibility and intensive support
  • 📣 Learn to be pragmatic and make quick and sustainable decisions
  • ⏱️ Flexible working hours, because we care about your outcome and not output

Helping usher the continent into a digital economy era. We’re not just about serving people - we’re about creating a marketplace to bring people what they need while infusing social values.
 
ABOUT THE ROLE :
 
We are looking for an experienced product manager to join our Super App and Mobility Initiative. You will join the team that leads and owns the Product vision and roadmap for Yassir Super App products. If you possess unparalleled strategic thinking, big picture person, business acumen, you are obsessed with customer jobs-to-be-done, and you are detailed-oriented, then we are looking for you!
 
TASKS : 
  • Work with customers to understand jobs to be done and design user journeys
  • Develop user stories translating business requirements into specifications the design and tech team can act upon 
  • Own the product roadmap and oversee its execution while balancing requirements across products and countries 
  • Contribute to the company culture and be responsible for the success and personal growth of our product managers 
  • Contribute to the company's overall strategy working closely with the engineering, data, and operations teams 
  • Manage the different stakeholders across countries and products
REQUIRMENTS :
 
  • +5 years experience as a product manager or in a similar senior-level position
  • management skills, ideally experience managing remote teams.
  • Experience in a rapidly growing company in the mobility, on-demand, or delivery space is a plus
  • BSc/MSc in Engineering, Computer Science, Design or relevant field
BENEFITS :
  • Great compensation and bonuses including stock options.
  • Ground floor opportunity with the team; shape the strategic direction of the company
  • Sharp, motivated co-workers in a fun office environment or in remote 
  • Paid company holidays
  • Full social coverage
WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN YASSIR :
 
  • Join one of the fastest-growing tech companies in North Africa
  • Have a lasting impact on our company's culture
  • Make a real impact on the world by helping us bring affordable financial and on-demand services to millions of Africans
  • Work on some really hard technical challenges from identity infrastructure for Africans, digital payment networks to complex mapping and routing systems across the continent.
  • We are the first Algerian startup to go through Y Combinator program and we’re backed by top investors including Unpopular Ventures, Rebel Fund and DainTree.VC

Role Summary
 
We’re hiring a Project Manager to drive execution of strategic and operational projects in Financial Services.You’ll run structured delivery across a wide range of initiatives — launching new services, integrating external partners, rolling out compliance and KYC/KYB policies, improving cash operations with agents/super agents, enabling new payment flows, etc.
 
You sit in the middle of Product, Compliance, Finance/Treasury, Engineering, Ops, and Growth. Your job is simple: keep the plan real, keep owners accountable, and land the project in production with minimal drama.

lists.content:
• 1. Project Delivery :
  • Own and drive end-to-end delivery of Financial Services projects from kick-off through launch.
  • Build and maintain clear project plans: scope, milestones, owners, deadlines, risks.
  • Push the project forward daily, unblock issues, and escalate when needed (before it’s on fire).
    •  
  • 2. Cross-Functional Coordination :
  • Align Product, Engineering, Compliance, Finance/Treasury, Ops, Growth, and external partners around one plan.
  • Make sure each team knows: what they owe, by when, and what happens if they slip.
  • Capture decisions in writing and circulate updates so there is one source of truth.
    •  
  • 3. Regulatory & Compliance Readiness :
  • Work with Compliance to ensure that projects respect internal policies (KYC/KYB, limits, AML triggers, cash handling, reporting).
  • Collect required documentation (policies, procedures, approval flows) and make sure they’re in place before go-live.
    •  
  • 4. Operational Readiness :
  • Ensure operational teams (agent network, support, finance ops, treasury, etc.) are ready to run the flow on Day 1.
  • Confirm that we know: who monitors transactions, how refunds or reversals work, escalation path for incidents, and how money settles.
    •  
  • 5. Launch & Stabilization :
  • Coordinate testing/UAT and sign-offs.
  • Run the go-live checklist and confirm all blockers are closed.
  • Monitor early performance and ensure any urgent post-launch fixes get an owner.

• On-time delivery of committed milestones.
  • Quality of launch (no major incident in first days/weeks).
  • Internal alignment: Compliance, Finance, and Ops signing off before go-live (not after).
  • Clarity of communication — no surprises for leadership.

• Must-haves :
  • ~2–4 years of experience in fintech / payments / banking / telecom value-added services / PSP / wallet / financial operations / similar high-ownership environment.
  • You’ve previously managed or coordinated delivery of cross-functional projects (not only “followed up,” but actually drove timelines).
  • You’re comfortable sitting with engineers to clarify requirements AND sitting with Ops/Treasury to confirm how money moves.
  • You’re disciplined with tracking: action logs, RAID logs (Risks / Assumptions / Issues / Dependencies), status reports.
  • Strong written communication. If something isn’t written down, you assume it’s not real.
    •  
  • Nice to have :
  • Exposure to regulated financial products (wallets, P2P, bill payment, settlement, limits/KYC).
  • Understanding of how funds flow, settlement/reconciliation, refunds, or cash collection works.
  • Familiarity with compliance topics (KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, limits by tier, AML escalation paths).
  • Experience coordinating external partners / vendors / billers.
    •  
  • Soft skills we care about
  • You escalate early, not emotionally.
  • You follow through. People learn that if you say “I’ll track this,” it’s tracked.
  • You’re comfortable saying “no, we’re not ready to launch yet” if Compliance/Finance hasn’t signed off.
  • You like structure. When there is none, you create it.

description:
À propos de Yassir :

Yassir est le numéro 1 des services à la demande (transport et livraison) dans la région Maghreb, qui disrupte les services quotidiens dans la région.

Yassir opère actuellement dans 26 villes en Algérie, Maroc et Tunisie avec des expansions récentes en France, Canada et Afrique sub-saharienne. Yassir est financée par des firmes de capital-risque mondiales et a levé plus de $43.5M y compris de Y Combinator qui est le précurseur d'Airbnb, Stripe, Dropbox, Doordash, entre autres. 

Nous ne nous contentons pas de servir nos clients nous leur apportant ce dont ils ont besoin tout en insufflant des valeurs sociales.

 

À propos du rôle :

  • Optimiser la vente des produits Yassir en développant le portefeuille clients entreprises de son secteur ;

  • Assurer le développement et la gestion de son portefeuille client.

 

Les tâches à accomplir :

  • Promouvoir l'offre des services de la société et contribuer au développement de la notoriété de la société,

  • Développer un portefeuille de prospects,

  • Analyser et comprendre les besoins des clients et leur proposer une solution adaptée en coordination avec le responsable,

  • Assurer la gestion de son portefeuille client dans le respect des procédures,

  • Assurer le onboarding des nouveaux clients et leur formation sur l’application ;

  • Élaborer des propositions commerciales en conformité avec la politique de l’entreprise,

  • Participer à la réalisation des objectifs de l’activité et l’augmentation du chiffre d'affaires

  • Atteindre les objectifs variables fixés par le responsable hiérarchique et la direction,

  • Transmettre les factures aux clients dans les délais,

  • Suivre les recouvrements des impayés de son portefeuille clients en collaboration avec le Superviseur Back-office,

 

 Profil requis :

  • Niveau universitaire BAC + 3 et plus en Commerce – Marketing – Management ;

  • Expérience de 1 à 2 années dans un poste similaire ;

  • Maîtrise des techniques de ventes ;

  • Maîtrise des techniques de négociation ;

  • Véhiculé(e)

  • Résolution de problèmes et être orienté(e) solution ;

  • Excellente capacité de communication et de relation interpersonnelle ;

  • Sens de l'écoute, rigueur et intégrité ;

  • Sens de la confidentialité

 

Privilèges :

  • L'occasion rare de changer le monde qui t’entoure de telle sorte qu’il utilise ton produit. Nous ne sommes pas juste une app, nous insufflons des valeurs sociales et réinventons la façon dont les services sont fournis dans notre région ;

  • Des collègues motivés dans un environnement de travail très convivial ;

  • Participation au lancement de nouveaux projets innovants.

 

Avantages :

  • Rémunération compétitive et bonus sur la performance ;

  • Complémentaire santé ;

  • Formation continue.

lists.content: • We are seeking a self-driven and results-oriented Sales manager to build and manage a robust agent distribution network for Yassir's Financial Services Product in Algeria. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in driving the product's growth and ensuring its success by establishing a network of agents strategically positioned for maximum impact. Every acquired agent will be responsible for helping Yassir users to deposit and withdraw cash from/to their Yassir’s in-app wallet

• Develop and execute a comprehensive strategy to acquire agents in high-potential areas.
  • Negotiate and onboard agents with a strong track record and commitment to Yassir's financial services product.
  • Design and deliver training programs for agents, equipping them with the knowledge and skills to effectively use the mobile money product.
  • Train agents on the product's benefits for both them (increased revenue) and their customers (financial inclusion, improved lives).
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with agents, fostering open communication and addressing their concerns promptly.
  • Develop and implement agent incentive programs to motivate them and drive continuous business growth with Yassir's mobile wallet.
  • Monitor agent network performance and ensure service uptime remains above 95%.
  • Proactively identify and address service disruptions to minimize downtime and maximize agent productivity.
  • Manage a team of on-ground sales personnel responsible for fulfilling agents' ongoing needs for e-money in their wallets and cash for their tills.
  • Motivate and coach the sales team to achieve set targets and contribute to the overall success of the agent network.

• Proven track record of success in building and managing sales networks, preferably in the financial services, telecom, FMCG, or Tobacco industries.
  • Experience in agent network management and channel development.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to develop and implement effective training programs.
  • Data-driven approach to problem-solving and performance optimization.
  • Deep understanding of mobile money products and their role in financial inclusion is a plus.

• Ground floor opportunity with the team; shape the strategic direction of the company
  • The rare opportunity to change the world around you such that everyone around you is using the product you built. We’re not just another app, we’re infusing social values and reinventing how services are provided
  • Sharp, motivated co-workers in a fun office environment

• Great compensation and bonuses including stock options.
  • Ground floor opportunity with the team; shape the strategic direction of the company
  • Sharp, motivated co-workers in a fun office environment.
  • Paid company holidays
  • Full social coverage

À propos de Yassir :
Yassir est la super application leader dans le domaine des services à la demande, opérant de manière prédominante dans la région du Maghreb. Yassir a pour mission de révolutionner la manière dont les services quotidiens sont accessibles.
Actuellement implantée dans plus de 45 villes à travers plusieurs pays tels que l'Algérie, le Maroc, la Tunisie et le Sénégal, notre présence s'étend aussi sur d'autres pays tels que la France et l'Afrique sub-saharienne.
Fortement soutenue par des investisseurs de renommée mondiale tels que BOND et Y Combinator, pionniers d'entreprises telles qu'Airbnb, Stripe, Dropbox, et Doordash, Yassir a réussi à faire de nombreuses levées de fonds équivalentes à presque 200 millions $.
Au-delà de la simple prestation de services, notre vision est de créer un marché dynamique visant à satisfaire les besoins de nos utilisateurs tout en insufflant des valeurs sociales fondamentales.

lists.content: • Rattaché au Directeur commercial, Le Sales Operations Specialist est le pilier administratif et opérationnel du service commercial, assurant le bon fonctionnement des processus liés à la plateforme de mobilité. Il/elle centralise la gestion des contrats, des accès clients et des réclamations, et est également responsable de la formation produit pour les équipes internes et les clients. Le Sales Operations Specialist supervise par ailleurs les activités de recouvrement et de facturation.

• ● Gestion Administrative et Support Opérationnel de la Plateforme de Mobilité :
  • Assurer la gestion administrative quotidienne de la plateforme de mobilité.
  • Centraliser et gérer l'ensemble des contrats commerciaux.
  • Attribuer et gérer les accès à la plateforme de mobilité pour les clients et les équipes.
  • Collaborer en mode transverse avec toutes les opérations (Yassir GO,
  • distribution).
  • Assurer les besoins des commerciaux en termes de fourniture de bureau,
  • documents administratifs, contrats.
    • ● Gestion des Doléances et Réclamations :
  • Garantir une bonne prise en charge des réclamations clients.
  • Traiter les doléances et réclamations liées aux aspects product et
  • opérationnels.
    • ● Supervision Recouvrement et Facturation :
  • Superviser le chargé de recouvrement et de facturation.
  • Assurer les recouvrements et le suivi des paiements avec la trésorerie.
  • Préparer les factures clients à remettre aux commerciaux avec suivi.
    • ● Formation Produit :
  • Développer et dispenser des formations sur le produit aux équipes
  • commerciales et aux clients.
  • Fournir un support aux commerciaux sur terrain.

Yassir est la super application leader dans le domaine des services à la demande, opérant de manière prédominante dans la région du Maghreb. Yassir a pour mission de révolutionner la manière dont les services quotidiens sont accessibles.
Actuellement implantée dans plus de 45 villes à travers plusieurs pays tels que l'Algérie, le Maroc, la Tunisie et le Sénégal, notre présence s'étend aussi sur d'autres pays tels que la France et l'Afrique sub-saharienne.
Fortement soutenue par des investisseurs de renommée mondiale tels que BOND et Y Combinator, pionniers d'entreprises telles qu'Airbnb, Stripe, Dropbox, et Doordash, Yassir a réussi à faire de nombreuses levées de fonds équivalentes à presque 200 millions $.
Au-delà de la simple prestation de services, notre vision est de créer un marché dynamique visant à satisfaire les besoins de nos utilisateurs tout en insufflant des valeurs sociales fondamentales.

descriptionPlain:
Yassir is the leading super App in the Maghreb region set to changing the way daily services are provided. It currently operates in 45 cities across Algeria, Morocco and Tunisia with recent expansions into France, Canada and Sub-Saharan Africa. It is backed (~$200M in funding) by VCs from Silicon Valley, Europe and other parts of the world.  
We offer on-demand services such as ride-hailing and last-mile delivery. Building on this infrastructure, we are now introducing financial services to help our users pay, save and borrow digitally. 
Helping usher the continent into a digital economy era. We’re not just about serving people - we’re about creating a marketplace to bring people what they need while infusing social values.
description:
Yassir is the leading super App in the Maghreb region set to changing the way daily services are provided. It currently operates in 45 cities across Algeria, Morocco and Tunisia with recent expansions into France, Canada and Sub-Saharan Africa. It is backed (~$200M in funding) by VCs from Silicon Valley, Europe and other parts of the world.
We offer on-demand services such as ride-hailing and last-mile delivery. Building on this infrastructure, we are now introducing financial services to help our users pay, save and borrow digitally.
Helping usher the continent into a digital economy era. We’re not just about serving people - we’re about creating a marketplace to bring people what they need while infusing social values.

ABOUT THE ROLE

  • Optimize the sale of Yassir products by developing the customer portfolio in the sector and ensuring the development and management of its customer portfolio.

TASKS

  • Promote the company's services and contribute to the development of its brand awareness.
  • Develop a portfolio of prospects and analyze their needs, proposing appropriate solutions in coordination with your manager.
  • Manage your customer portfolio in compliance with procedures and onboard new customers, providing them with necessary training on the application.
  • Develop sales proposals in line with company policy and participate in achieving business objectives and increasing sales.
  • Meet variable targets set by your line manager and management and ensure invoices are passed on to customers on time.
  • Monitor the collection of unpaid invoices from the customer portfolio in collaboration with the Back-office Supervisor.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Diploma and/or training in Commerce - Marketing.
  • 3 to 5 years' experience in a similar position.
  • Excellent knowledge of sales and negotiation techniques.
  • Computer skills.
  • Problem-solving and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a sense of confidentiality and integrity.

BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation and bonuses, including stock options.
  • Ground floor opportunity to shape the strategic direction of the company.
  • Work with sharp, motivated coworkers in a fun office environment.
  • Full social coverage.

PERKS

  • Opportunity to shape the strategic direction of the company.
  • Contribute to changing the world by providing innovative services.
  • Work with sharp, motivated coworkers in a fun office environment.
