À propos de Yassir :

Yassir est la super application leader dans le domaine des services à la demande, opérant de manière prédominante dans la région du Maghreb. Yassir a pour mission de révolutionner la manière dont les services quotidiens sont accessibles.

Actuellement implantée dans plus de 45 villes à travers plusieurs pays tels que l'Algérie, le Maroc, la Tunisie et le Sénégal, notre présence s'étend aussi sur d'autres pays tels que la France et l'Afrique sub-saharienne.

Fortement soutenue par des investisseurs de renommée mondiale tels que BOND et Y Combinator, pionniers d'entreprises telles qu'Airbnb, Stripe, Dropbox, et Doordash, Yassir a réussi à faire de nombreuses levées de fonds équivalentes à presque 200 millions $.

Au-delà de la simple prestation de services, notre vision est de créer un marché dynamique visant à satisfaire les besoins de nos utilisateurs tout en insufflant des valeurs sociales fondamentales.

Rôle :

Nous recherchons un Sales Representative (terrain) motivé et orienté résultats pour rejoindre notre équipe en pleine croissance !
Rattaché à un Team Leader, tu joueras un rôle essentiel dans le développement des services financiers de Yassir dans ta région.
Ta mission principale : acquérir de nouveaux agents, entretenir des relations solides avec les agents existants, et faire croître l’activité sur ton territoire.

 

Missions :

  • Identifier et cibler de manière proactive les commerçants à fort potentiel pour leur proposer de devenir agents Yassir.

  • Présenter le produit agent wallet (portefeuille agent), en mettant en avant ses avantages pour les agents (revenus supplémentaires) et leurs clients (inclusion financière).

  • Négocier et intégrer de nouveaux agents, tout en s’assurant qu’ils comprennent bien les offres et les conditions contractuelles.

  • Entretenir des relations solides avec les agents assignés, assurer une communication fluide et répondre rapidement à leurs préoccupations.

  • Réaliser des visites régulières pour garantir la satisfaction des agents et leur fournir un support continu.

  • Développer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies pour accroître le volume de transactions et les revenus générés par le réseau d’agents.

  • Identifier les opportunités de vente additionnelle des services Yassir auprès des agents existants.

  • Surveiller en permanence le bon fonctionnement du service chez les agents, détecter les blocages éventuels.

  • Aider les agents à résoudre les interruptions de service et s’assurer que leurs portefeuilles électroniques sont toujours approvisionnés (argent digital ou espèces).

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le Team Leader pour résoudre les problèmes de liquidité des agents et garantir la fluidité des opérations.

Profil recherché :

  • Minimum 2 ans d’expérience dans la vente, idéalement dans les services financiers, les télécoms, le tabac ou les produits de grande consommation (FMCG)

  • Excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et relations interpersonnelles

  • Capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec les clients

  • Motivation personnelle, esprit de conquête, orienté résultats

  • Bon sens de l’organisation et gestion du temps

  • À l’aise avec les applications mobiles

  • Permis de conduire et véhicule obligatoire (voiture)

descriptionPlain:
ABOUT Yassir :
 
Yassir is the leading super App in the Maghreb region set to changing the way daily services are provided. It currently operates in 45 cities across Algeria, Morocco and Tunisia with recent expansions into France, Canada and Sub-Saharan Africa. It is backed (~$200M in funding) by VCs from Silicon Valley, Europe and other parts of the world.
We offer on-demand services such as ride-hailing and last-mile delivery. Building on this infrastructure, we are now introducing financial services to help our users pay, save and borrow digitally.
Helping usher the continent into a digital economy era. We’re not just about serving people - we’re about creating a marketplace to bring people what they need while infusing social values. 
 
Tasks : 
Proactively identify and target high-potential merchants within the assigned area to acquire new agents for Yassir's financial services product.
Present the agent wallet product to potential agents, highlighting its benefits for them (increased revenue) and their customers (financial inclusion).
Negotiate and onboard new agents, ensuring they understand the product offering and contractual terms.
Build and maintain strong relationships with assigned agents, fostering open communication and addressing their concerns promptly.
Conduct regular visits to agents to ensure they are satisfied with the service and provide ongoing support.
Develop and implement strategies to grow transaction volume and revenue generated through the assigned agent network.
Identify opportunities to upsell existing agents on additional Yassir services or features.
Proactively monitor service uptime for assigned agents and identify any issues impacting their ability to serve customers.
Assist agents in resolving service disruptions and ensure Yassir wallets are functioning properly by constantly availing e-money in their agent wallets and/or cash in their tills
Work collaboratively with the Sales Team Leader to address any challenges related to agent liquidity and ensure timely cash flow for transactions.

Fortement soutenue par des investisseurs de renommée mondiale tels que BOND et Y Combinator, pionniers d'entreprises telles qu'Airbnb, Stripe, Dropbox, et Doordash, Yassir a réussi à faire de nombreuses levées de fonds équivalentes à presque 200 millions $.

Au-delà de la simple prestation de services, notre vision est de créer un marché dynamique visant à satisfaire les besoins de nos utilisateurs tout en insufflant des valeurs sociales fondamentales.

Rôle :

Nous recherchons un Sales Representative (terrain) motivé et orienté résultats pour rejoindre notre équipe en pleine croissance !
Rattaché à un Team Leader, tu joueras un rôle essentiel dans le développement des services financiers de Yassir dans ta région.
Ta mission principale : acquérir de nouveaux agents, entretenir des relations solides avec les agents existants, et faire croître l’activité sur ton territoire.

 

Missions :

  • Identifier et cibler de manière proactive les commerçants à fort potentiel pour leur proposer de devenir agents Yassir.

  • Présenter le produit agent wallet (portefeuille agent), en mettant en avant ses avantages pour les agents (revenus supplémentaires) et leurs clients (inclusion financière).

  • Négocier et intégrer de nouveaux agents, tout en s’assurant qu’ils comprennent bien les offres et les conditions contractuelles.

  • Entretenir des relations solides avec les agents assignés, assurer une communication fluide et répondre rapidement à leurs préoccupations.

  • Réaliser des visites régulières pour garantir la satisfaction des agents et leur fournir un support continu.

  • Développer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies pour accroître le volume de transactions et les revenus générés par le réseau d’agents.

  • Identifier les opportunités de vente additionnelle des services Yassir auprès des agents existants.

  • Surveiller en permanence le bon fonctionnement du service chez les agents, détecter les blocages éventuels.

  • Aider les agents à résoudre les interruptions de service et s’assurer que leurs portefeuilles électroniques sont toujours approvisionnés (argent digital ou espèces).

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le Team Leader pour résoudre les problèmes de liquidité des agents et garantir la fluidité des opérations.

Profil recherché :

  • Minimum 2 ans d’expérience dans la vente, idéalement dans les services financiers, les télécoms, le tabac ou les produits de grande consommation (FMCG)

  • Excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et relations interpersonnelles

  • Capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec les clients

  • Motivation personnelle, esprit de conquête, orienté résultats

  • Bon sens de l’organisation et gestion du temps

  • À l’aise avec les applications mobiles

  • Permis de conduire et véhicule obligatoire (voiture)

descriptionPlain:
Yassir is the leading super App in the Maghreb region set to changing the way daily services are provided. It currently operates in 45 cities across Algeria, Morocco and Tunisia with recent expansions into France, Canada and Sub-Saharan Africa. It is backed (~$200M in funding) by VCs from Silicon Valley, Europe and other parts of the world.  
We offer on-demand services such as ride-hailing and last-mile delivery. Building on this infrastructure, we are now introducing financial services to help our users pay, save and borrow digitally. 
Helping usher the continent into a digital economy era. We’re not just about serving people - we’re about creating a marketplace to bring people what they need while infusing social values.

salaryDescription:
ABOUT THE ROLE

  • Optimize the sale of Yassir products by developing the customer portfolio in the sector and ensuring the development and management of its customer portfolio.

TASKS

  • Promote the company's services and contribute to the development of its brand awareness.
  • Develop a portfolio of prospects and analyze their needs, proposing appropriate solutions in coordination with your manager.
  • Manage your customer portfolio in compliance with procedures and onboard new customers, providing them with necessary training on the application.
  • Develop sales proposals in line with company policy and participate in achieving business objectives and increasing sales.
  • Meet variable targets set by your line manager and management and ensure invoices are passed on to customers on time.
  • Monitor the collection of unpaid invoices from the customer portfolio in collaboration with the Back-office Supervisor.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Diploma and/or training in Commerce - Marketing.
  • 3 to 5 years' experience in a similar position.
  • Excellent knowledge of sales and negotiation techniques.
  • Computer skills.
  • Problem-solving and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a sense of confidentiality and integrity.

lists.content:
Nous recherchons un Sales Representative (Commercial terrain) motivé et orienté résultats pour rejoindre notre équipe en pleine croissance !
Rattaché à un Team Leader, tu joueras un rôle essentiel dans le développement des services financiers de Yassir dans ta région.
Ta mission principale : acquérir de nouveaux agents, entretenir des relations solides avec les agents existants, et faire croître l’activité sur ton territoire.

• Identifier et cibler de manière proactive les commerçants à fort potentiel pour leur proposer de devenir agents Yassir.

  • Présenter le produit agent wallet (portefeuille agent), en mettant en avant ses avantages pour les agents (revenus supplémentaires) et leurs clients (inclusion financière).

  • Négocier et intégrer de nouveaux agents, tout en s’assurant qu’ils comprennent bien les offres et les conditions contractuelles.

  • Entretenir des relations solides avec les agents assignés, assurer une communication fluide et répondre rapidement à leurs préoccupations.

  • Réaliser des visites régulières pour garantir la satisfaction des agents et leur fournir un support continu.

  • Développer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies pour accroître le volume de transactions et les revenus générés par le réseau d’agents.

  • Identifier les opportunités de vente additionnelle des services Yassir auprès des agents existants.

  • Surveiller en permanence le bon fonctionnement du service chez les agents, détecter les blocages éventuels.

  • Aider les agents à résoudre les interruptions de service et s’assurer que leurs portefeuilles électroniques sont toujours approvisionnés (argent digital ou espèces).

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le Team Leader pour résoudre les problèmes de liquidité des agents et garantir la fluidité des opérations.

• Minimum 2 ans d’expérience dans la vente, idéalement dans les services financiers, les télécoms, le tabac ou les produits de grande consommation (FMCG)

  • Excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et relations interpersonnelles

  • Capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec les clients

  • Motivation personnelle, esprit de conquête, orienté résultats

  • Bon sens de l’organisation et gestion du temps

  • À l’aise avec les applications mobiles

  • Permis de conduire et véhicule obligatoire (voiture)

lists.content: • Le Sales Representative aura pour mission principale d'optimiser les ventes d’un secteur géographique donné en réalisant des visites régulières chez les clients existants ou potentiels. Il anticipe les besoins des clients et propose des solutions adaptées tout en contribuant à la fidélisation et à l’augmentation du volume des ventes.

• Identifier et prospecter de nouveaux clients potentiels dans le secteur géographique attribué.

  • Prendre contact avec des prospects pour présenter les produits ou services de l’entreprise.

  • Développer les relations commerciales avec les clients existants pour en maximiser le potentiel.

  • Assurer un suivi régulier des clients et prospects pour garantir une relation à long terme.

• Formation : Bac+2 en commerce, vente, ou domaine similaire.

  • Expérience : Une première expérience dans le domaine commercial ou en tant que pré vendeur est souhaitée.

  • Qualités personnelles : Dynamique, réactif, autonome, avec une bonne capacité à travailler en équipe et à s’adapter à des situations diverses.

  • Véhicule personnel obligatoire.

descriptionBody:
À propos de Yassir :

Yassir est la super application leader dans le domaine des services à la demande, opérant de manière prédominante dans la région du Maghreb. Yassir a pour mission de révolutionner la manière dont les services quotidiens sont accessibles.

Actuellement implantée dans plus de 45 villes à travers plusieurs pays tels que l'Algérie, le Maroc, la Tunisie et le Sénégal, notre présence s'étend aussi sur d'autres pays tels que la France et l'Afrique sub-saharienne.

Fortement soutenue par des investisseurs de renommée mondiale tels que BOND et Y Combinator, pionniers d'entreprises telles qu'Airbnb, Stripe, Dropbox, et Doordash, Yassir a réussi à faire de nombreuses levées de fonds équivalentes à presque 200 millions $.

Au-delà de la simple prestation de services, notre vision est de créer un marché dynamique visant à satisfaire les besoins de nos utilisateurs tout en insufflant des valeurs sociales fondamentales.

descriptionPlain:
À propos de Yassir
Yassir est la super-app leader dans la région du Maghreb, qui vise à transformer la manière dont les services du quotidien sont fournis. Elle opère actuellement dans 45 villes en Algérie, au Maroc et en Tunisie, avec des expansions récentes en France, au Canada et en Afrique subsaharienne. L’entreprise est soutenue par des fonds de capital-risque de la Silicon Valley, d’Europe et d’autres régions du monde, avec près de 200 millions de dollars de financement.
Nous proposons des services à la demande tels que le transport (ride-hailing) et la livraison du dernier kilomètre. En nous appuyant sur cette infrastructure, nous introduisons désormais des services financiers afin d’aider nos utilisateurs à payer, épargner et emprunter de manière digitale.
Notre objectif est d’accompagner le continent vers une économie numérique. Nous ne nous contentons pas de servir les utilisateurs : nous créons un véritable marketplace qui permet aux personnes d’accéder à ce dont elles ont besoin, tout en intégrant des valeurs sociales.
 
Rôle:
Nous recherchons un Sales Representative terrain motivé(e) et orienté(e) résultats pour rejoindre notre équipe en pleine croissance !
Rattaché à un Team Leader, tu joueras un rôle essentiel dans le développement des services financiers de Yassir dans ta région.
Ta mission principale : acquérir de nouveaux agents, entretenir des relations solides avec les agents existants, et faire croître l’activité sur ton territoire.
Missions:
Identifier et cibler de manière proactive les commerçants à fort potentiel pour leur proposer de devenir agents Yassir.
Présenter le produit agent wallet (portefeuille agent), en mettant en avant ses avantages pour les agents (revenus supplémentaires) et leurs clients (inclusion financière).
Négocier et intégrer de nouveaux agents, tout en s’assurant qu’ils comprennent bien les offres et les conditions contractuelles.
Entretenir des relations solides avec les agents assignés, assurer une communication fluide et répondre rapidement à leurs préoccupations.
Réaliser des visites régulières pour garantir la satisfaction des agents et leur fournir un support continu.
Développer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies pour accroître le volume de transactions et les revenus générés par le réseau d’agents.
Identifier les opportunités de vente additionnelle des services Yassir auprès des agents existants.
Surveiller en permanence le bon fonctionnement du service chez les agents, détecter les blocages éventuels.
Aider les agents à résoudre les interruptions de service et s’assurer que leurs portefeuilles électroniques sont toujours approvisionnés (argent digital ou espèces).
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le Team Leader pour résoudre les problèmes de liquidité des agents et garantir la fluidité des opérations.
Profil :
Minimum 2 ans d’expérience dans la vente, idéalement dans les services financiers, les télécoms, le tabac ou les produits de grande consommation (FMCG)
Excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et relations interpersonnelles
Capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec les clients
Motivation personnelle, esprit de conquête, orienté(e) résultats
Bon sens de l’organisation et gestion du temps
À l’aise avec les applications mobiles
Permis de conduire et véhicule obligatoire (voiture)

L’entreprise est soutenue par des fonds de capital-risque de la Silicon Valley, d’Europe et d’autres régions du monde, avec près de 200 millions de dollars de financement.
Nous proposons des services à la demande tels que le transport (ride-hailing) et la livraison du dernier kilomètre. En nous appuyant sur cette infrastructure, nous introduisons désormais des services financiers afin d’aider nos utilisateurs à payer, épargner et emprunter de manière digitale.
Notre objectif est d’accompagner le continent vers une économie numérique. Nous ne nous contentons pas de servir les utilisateurs : nous créons un véritable marketplace qui permet aux personnes d’accéder à ce dont elles ont besoin, tout en intégrant des valeurs sociales.
 
Rôle:
Nous recherchons un Sales Representative terrain motivé(e) et orienté(e) résultats pour rejoindre notre équipe en pleine croissance !
Rattaché à un Team Leader, tu joueras un rôle essentiel dans le développement des services financiers de Yassir dans ta région.
Ta mission principale : acquérir de nouveaux agents, entretenir des relations solides avec les agents existants, et faire croître l’activité sur ton territoire.
Missions:
Identifier et cibler de manière proactive les commerçants à fort potentiel pour leur proposer de devenir agents Yassir.
Présenter le produit agent wallet (portefeuille agent), en mettant en avant ses avantages pour les agents (revenus supplémentaires) et leurs clients (inclusion financière).
Négocier et intégrer de nouveaux agents, tout en s’assurant qu’ils comprennent bien les offres et les conditions contractuelles.
Entretenir des relations solides avec les agents assignés, assurer une communication fluide et répondre rapidement à leurs préoccupations.
Réaliser des visites régulières pour garantir la satisfaction des agents et leur fournir un support continu.
Développer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies pour accroître le volume de transactions et les revenus générés par le réseau d’agents.
Identifier les opportunités de vente additionnelle des services Yassir auprès des agents existants.
Surveiller en permanence le bon fonctionnement du service chez les agents, détecter les blocages éventuels.
Aider les agents à résoudre les interruptions de service et s’assurer que leurs portefeuilles électroniques sont toujours approvisionnés (argent digital ou espèces).
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le Team Leader pour résoudre les problèmes de liquidité des agents et garantir la fluidité des opérations.
Profil :
Minimum 2 ans d’expérience dans la vente, idéalement dans les services financiers, les télécoms, le tabac ou les produits de grande consommation (FMCG)
Excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et relations interpersonnelles
Capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec les clients
Motivation personnelle, esprit de conquête, orienté(e) résultats
Bon sens de l’organisation et gestion du temps
À l’aise avec les applications mobiles
Permis de conduire et véhicule obligatoire (voiture)

About the Role

Yassir is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Analyst, of junior / mid / senior level, to join our Data Analytics team and contribute with shaping the business’s decision making and product offering on Financial Services in making it more data and insights driven. As a Data Analyst (FinTech), you will play a crucial role in analyzing data, helping us prioritize, assess, develop financial product features for our millions of users across Africa. Your expertise in both data processing, robust statistical analysis, insights derivation, hypothesis formulation and data visualization will be essential in driving our solutions and providing value to Yassir. This is a very exciting opportunity, tackling some of Yassir’s most critical problems.

lists.content: The Data Analytics team is part of Yassir’s central Data & AI domain, which is responsible for all data related activities in the organization - from Data Engineering, Data Platform management and Data Analytics all the way to AI solutions and MLOps infrastructure development. We are a global team of Data and AI / ML experts, encompassing diverse backgrounds and skills. We strive to provide top-quality Analytics and BI insights to the business, being a proactive partner to our stakeholders, and ultimately to build a mature Data Culture supported by widespread data fluency, responsible and democratized data access, data-driven decision making and automation. We push the envelope of what’s feasible, we challenge each other, we support each other, and we take great pride in our work. Most of all we are value-driven to create impact from our data solutions. If you have an inherent curiosity about the fields Data and AI, a relevant background and an internal zeal and drive to contribute, please come join us!

• Analyze customer, transaction, merchant, and agent data to identify trends, opportunities, and performance drivers across Wallets, Payments, Bill Payments, Merchant Payments, P2P Transfers, and other Financial Services products.

  • Partner with Product Managers, Operations, Risk, Finance, and Engineering teams to answer business questions through data and support product decision-making.

  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking frameworks to monitor customer growth, engagement, retention, transaction performance, and revenue metrics.

  • Conduct deep-dive analyses on customer behavior, payment funnels, wallet activation, transaction success rates, merchant activity, and agent performance.

  • Support product discovery and feature development by identifying customer pain points, behavioral patterns, and growth opportunities using data.

  • Design, execute, and evaluate A/B tests, feature launches, promotional campaigns, and product experiments to measure impact and guide future improvements.

  • Work closely with Data Science and Risk teams to support customer segmentation, fraud monitoring, credit risk analysis, and predictive modeling initiatives.

  • Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover actionable insights and support the development of data-driven product enhancements.

  • Monitor data quality, identify anomalies, and collaborate with Data Engineering teams to improve tracking, instrumentation, and reporting accuracy.

  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through presentations, reports, and dashboards.

Essential

  • 2–5 years of experience in Product Analytics, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related analytical role.

  • Strong SQL skills and practical experience working with large-scale customer and transaction datasets.

  • Proficiency in Python for data analysis, statistical modeling, and data visualization.

  • Experience working with digital products, preferably within Fintech, Payments, Wallets, Banking, Lending, or Financial Services.

  • Solid understanding of statistics, hypothesis testing, experimentation, and data-driven decision-making.

  • Experience building dashboards and reports using BI tools such as Looker Studio, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.

  • Ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches and communicate insights effectively to stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery.

  • Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

    • Nice to have

    • Experience working with Wallets, Bill Payments, Merchant Payments, P2P Transfers, Agent Networks, Lending, or Credit products.

    • Familiarity with fraud analytics, risk monitoring, customer lifecycle analysis, or fintech growth metrics.

    • Exposure to machine learning, customer segmentation, or predictive analytics use cases.

      • Join the ride!

lists.content: The AI team is part of Yassir’s central Data & AI domain, which is responsible for all data related activities in the organization - from Data Engineering, Data Platform management and Data Analytics all the way to AI solutions and MLOps infrastructure development. We are a global team of Data and AI / ML experts, encompassing diverse backgrounds and skills. We strive to build state-of-the-art Data and ML infrastructure and solutions, and ultimately a Data Culture supported by responsible and democratized data access, data-driven decision making and automation. We push the envelope of what’s feasible, we challenge each other, we support each other, and we take great pride in our work. Most of all we are value-driven to create impact from our data solutions. If you have an inherent curiosity about the fields Data and AI, a relevant background and an internal zeal and drive to contribute, please come join us!

• Become an expert point of contact and thought leader on your scope by mastering the details and principles pertaining to it.

  • Some key areas we have to focus include: optimizing our Pricing capabilities, such as Dynamic / Surge Pricing, Discounts / Commissioning Optimization and Personalized Pricing, optimizing our Dispatching capabilities, optimizing our Fraud Detection / Revenue Leakage Prevention capabilities, optimizing our Recommendations / Personalization capabilities, amongst others.

  • Identify and propose ML opportunities related to your scope and beyond

  • Support with requirements definition and prioritization of ML projects

  • Collaborate with cross-functional Engineering and Product teams

  • Champion Data Quality as a critical input component to all ML solutions and Analytics

  • Conduct Exploratory Data Analysis and subsequent Feature Selection / Engineering

  • Utilize Statistical and ML techniques, as appropriate, for model training

  • Validate and tune ML models

  • Visualize analysis / modelling results focusing on meaningful, actionable metrics and insights

  • Deploy and test ML applications using our MLOps infrastructureMonitor ML models on their technical performance, business impact and underlying data / concept drift

  • Explain technical solutions in a business-friendly manner, supporting Product teams in their communications and reporting

  • Maintain and improve technical documentation of delivered solutions

  • Support the Data & AI domain in developing its technical capabilities, improving its ways of working and collaboration with other dependent teams

  • Champion Data Culture, proactively share knowledge across teams, and participate and drive team building activities

• Solid Mathematical / Statistical / Machine Learning as well as Software Development technical skills - supported by a Masters degree or above in a relevant quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Operational Research, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics

  • Comfortable in efficient, production quality Python and SQL coding at a professional setting with at least 2 years of industry experience (more years of experience would be required for more Senior roles)

  • Comfortable with key software engineering concepts, such as code / memory profiling, code optimization, scalability, code / QA testing, cost optimization and associated best practices.

  • Comfortable with key Statistical concepts, such as statistical testing and causal analysis

  • Analytical thinking and problem solving skills

  • Engineering mindset focused towards delivering robust applied data science solutions

  • Visualization skills, including experience with common Python ecosystem libraries and/or Analytics / BI tooling

  • Familiarity and prior use of Cloud solutions and their data / ML services - at Yassir we use Google Cloud Platform (GCP), experience with which is highly preferred

  • Mastering of the end-to-end (ML) model development lifecycle

  • Excellent communication skills, including presentation and oral / written communication (clear articulation, concise documentation) in professional English

  • Positive attitude and resilience

  • Strong interpersonal skills focused on peer support, empathy, active listening, team building and stakeholder relationships building

  • Internal drive, self-motivation and ability to work independently including own effective project management

• Experience with Financial Services companies

  • Experience working on ML features for Digital Products (apps, websites)

  • Experience with one or more from: Pricing / Economics related projects and/or modelling techniques (we welcome Economics / Econometrics backgrounds and experience), Fraud Detection related projects, Dispatching related projects, Personalization related projects

lists.text: About your role as “Senior Java Engineer”
lists.content:
• Build robust and scalable software in Java (Spring, Spring boot & hibernate)

  • Design and create (micro)services and system architecture for projects, and contribute and provide feedback to other team members.

  • Help improve existing code quality through writing unit tests, automation and performing code reviews.

  • Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas to our technology, algorithms and products.

  • Work with the engineering and design teams to understand end-user requirements, formulate use cases, and then translate that into a pragmatic and effective technical solution.

  • Dive into difficult problems and successfully deliver results on schedule.

• BSc/MSc in Engineering, Computer Science or relevant field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize, self-start, contribute under pressure and meet tight deadlines
  • Highly organized, creative and critical thinker
  • Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment
  • Solid OOP and software design knowledge – you should know how to create software that is extensible, reusable and meets desired architectural objectives
    • Must have technical skills:

  • Language: Java.

  • Database: Mongodb or other.

  • Framework: Spring boot and hibernate.

  • Web architecture: Rest and restful APIs, micro-services

  • TDD

  • Containers: Docker, kubernetes

  • Caching, Redis server

  • Web load balancing

  • Scaling 
  • OS administration

  • Encryption : https//, digital signing

lists.text: About your role as “Senior Android Engineer”
lists.content:
• Design and build mobile applications for Android.

  • Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications

  • Collaborate with a team to define, design, and ship new features

  • Identify and correct bottlenecks and fix bugs

  • Help maintain code quality, organization, and automatization

  • Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas to our technology, algorithms and products.

  • Work with the engineering and design teams to understand end-user requirements, formulate use cases, and then translate that into a pragmatic and effective technical solution

  • Dive into difficult problems and successfully deliver results on schedule

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Android app development.

  • Proven track record of delivering high-quality, user-friendly Android applications.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.

  • Expert proficiency in Kotlin with a deep understanding of its advanced features.

  • Extensive experience with Jetpack Compose and building UI components in a declarative paradigm.

  • Strong understanding of the Android SDK, including UI design principles, patterns, and best practices.

  • Experience with asynchronous programming and multithreading in Android.

  • Proficient in integrating RESTful APIs and working with JSON data format.

  • Familiarity with dependency injection frameworks like Dagger/Hilt.

  • Experience with Android Architecture Components (ViewModel, LiveData, Room, Navigation).

  • Solid understanding of MVI and other architectural patterns.

  • Proficient with version control systems, particularly Git, and experience with GitFlow workflow.

  • Experience with unit testing (JUnit, Mockito) and UI testing (Espresso).

  • Knowledge of Gradle build system and managing project dependencies.

  • Understanding of material design principles and ability to implement them effectively.

  • Familiarity with app performance optimization and tools like Android Profiler.

  • Experience with Google Play Store deployment and app release management.

  • Knowledge of backend technologies and experience with Firebase or other backend services.

  • Experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Bitrise.

  • Understanding of secure coding practices and experience with encryption and data protection on Android.

  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.

It currently operates in 45 cities across Algeria, Morocco and Tunisia with recent expansions into France, Canada and Sub-Saharan Africa. It is backed (~$200M in funding) by VCs from Silicon Valley, Europe and other parts of the world.
We offer on-demand services such as ride-hailing and last-mile delivery. Building on this infrastructure, we are now introducing financial services to help our users pay, save and borrow digitally.
Helping usher the continent into a digital economy era. We’re not just about serving people - we’re about creating a marketplace to bring people what they need while infusing social values.

ABOUT THE ROLE

In this role, you will be part of our engineering team, working with a high-quality codebase and the latest tools, where you will develop your expertise as an expert in complex frontend development on iOS (Swift and SwiftUI) native platforms. Your primary focus will be on the development of mobile applications and their integration with back-end services. You will be working alongside other engineers and developers working on different layers of the infrastructure. Therefore, a commitment to a highly dynamic environment is required, where root cause analysis and rapid collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, and the creation of quality products are required.

  • Design and build mobile applications for iOS.

  • Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications

  • Collaborate with a team to define, design, and ship new features

  • Identify and correct bottlenecks and fix bugs

  • Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation

  • Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas to our technology, algorithms, and products.

  • Work with the engineering and design teams to understand end-user requirements, formulate use cases, and then translate that into a pragmatic and effective technical solution

  • Dive into difficult problems and successfully deliver results on schedule

Requirements

Must have technical skills with at least 5 years of experience

  • Language: iOS (Swift) native

  • Familiarity with cloud message APIs and push notification

  • Web architecture: REST and RESTful APIs, micro-services

  • Version control: GIT

  • BSc/MSc in Engineering, Computer Science or relevant field

Nice to have technical skills (Strongly advised)

  • Containers: Docker, Kubernetes

  • Caching, Redis server

  • Scaling, Web load balancing

descriptionPlain:
À propos de Yassir : 
Yassir est la super application leader dans le domaine des services à la demande, opérant de manière prédominante dans la région du Maghreb. Yassir a pour mission de révolutionner la manière dont les services quotidiens sont accessibles.

Actuellement implantée dans plus de 45 villes à travers plusieurs pays tels que l'Algérie, le Maroc, la Tunisie et le Sénégal, notre présence s'étend aussi sur d'autres pays tels que la France et l'Afrique sub-saharienne.

Fortement soutenue par des investisseurs de renommée mondiale tels que BOND et Y Combinator, pionniers d'entreprises telles qu'Airbnb, Stripe, Dropbox, et Doordash, Yassir a réussi à faire de nombreuses levées de fonds équivalentes à presque 200 millions $.

Au-delà de la simple prestation de services, notre vision est de créer un marché dynamique visant à satisfaire les besoins de nos utilisateurs tout en insufflant des valeurs sociales fondamentales.

lists.content: • Le poste de Senior Multimedia Designer se situe au sein du département Marketing / Communication / Design. Ce rôle est essentiel pour assurer la conception et la production de contenus visuels et multimédias innovants et cohérents avec l'identité de l'entreprise. Le titulaire du poste aura pour mission de créer des supports graphiques et interactifs pour différents canaux (print, digital, vidéo, motion design), de superviser les projets créatifs et de collaborer étroitement avec les équipes marketing, produit et communication afin de garantir l'impact visuel et l'harmonisation des contenus.

• Concevoir et produire des contenus graphiques et multimédias pour les supports digitaux et print.
  • Garantir la cohérence de la charte graphique et de l’identité visuelle de l’entreprise.
  • Participer à la définition des concepts créatifs et proposer des idées innovantes.
  • Gérer et suivre les projets de la conception à la livraison dans le respect des délais et budgets.
  • Assurer une veille sur les tendances graphiques, numériques et multimédias.
  • Encadrer et conseiller les designers juniors ou freelances, si nécessaire.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes marketing, produit et communication pour intégrer les contenus dans les campagnes et supports.
  • Optimiser les livrables pour différents formats et supports (web, mobile, social media, print).

• Formation supérieure en Design graphique, Multimédia, Communication visuelle ou domaine équivalent.
  • Expérience significative (5 à 8 ans) sur un poste similaire.
  • Maîtrise avancée des outils Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro) et outils de conception UX/UI.
  • Capacité à produire des contenus créatifs, attractifs et innovants.
  • Sens de l’organisation et capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément.
  • Aptitudes à travailler en équipe et à communiquer efficacement avec différents services.
  • Maîtrise du français et idéalement de l’anglais.

• Maîtrise des outils de création multimédia (Adobe Suite, motion design, UX/UI)
  • Conception graphique et production de contenus innovants
  • Gestion de projets créatifs
  • Veille et adaptation aux tendances graphiques et numériques
  • Optimisation des livrables pour différents supports
  • Créativité et innovation
  • Communication et collaboration interservices
  • Gestion du temps et respect des délais
  • Esprit d’équipe et leadership sur les projets

lists.content:
Role Summary

 

Owns end-to-end pricing strategy across markets, leads benchmark and pricing model design, and partners with Product, Data team, and Operations to maximize revenue per trip while balancing supply-demand health. Mentors junior specialists and drives cross-functional pricing initiatives.

Core Responsibilities

 

•       Design and own tarification strategy , pricing models (time, zone, events, elasticity)

•       Lead A/B price experiments from hypothesis to statistically valid conclusions

•       Build revenue forecasting models and scenario planning frameworks

•       Conduct competitive benchmarking and market-level pricing calibration

•       Translate pricing logic into clear product requirements for Engineering

•       Mentor Pricing Specialists and review their analyses before delivery

•       Present pricing strategy (Mobility & LMD) and results to senior leadership, daily, weekly, monthly,..)

 Required Skills

 

  •  Data analysis

  •  Price Elasticity Modeling  

  •  Revenue Optimization    

  •  Looker / Tableau / Data Studio /BI/ Advanced Excel

  •  Stakeholder Communication 

  •  Marketplace Dynamics    

    •  Qualifications

     

    •       3+ years in pricing, revenue management, or quantitative analytics

    •       Degree in Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or Data science (Master's preferred)

    •       Prior experience in ride-hailing, e-commerce, or marketplace platforms

    •       Track record of leading cross-functional projects end-to-end

descriptionPlain:
Yassir is the leading super App in the Maghreb region set to changing the way daily services are provided. It currently operates in 45 cities across Algeria, Morocco and Tunisia with recent expansions into France, Canada and Sub-Saharan Africa. It is backed (~$200M in funding) by VCs from Silicon Valley, Europe and other parts of the world.  
We offer on-demand services such as ride-hailing and last-mile delivery. Building on this infrastructure, we are now introducing financial services to help our users pay, save and borrow digitally. 
Helping usher the continent into a digital economy era. We’re not just about serving people - we’re about creating a marketplace to bring people what they need while infusing social values.


Introduction

The Tech organization in Yassir is applying engineering and product “best practices” - to operate efficiently and build secured, efficient and user-friendly products and services - that can scale and be platformized across different business domains. We’ve identified one area that can provide both tech excellence and business impact: authentication of users across our products and offerings.  The desired state of Authentication is one of a central, secure, efficient and scalable, initially for 1st party web and native applications, and later - for untrusted 3rd parties.Central authentication is one of the core competencies of a tech company, which is not measured by ROI or other financial/business matrices. It is measured by product and engineering metrics, such as login conversion rate, # of accounts creation, # of security incidents, etc. Central authentication could pave the way for our own digital identity platform and IDP.

Identity Provider (IDP)

Identity platform will allow Yassir to be a leading identity provider (IDP) in its region, offering frictionless and secured access to sites, apps and tools, including portability of data and digital assets, such as digital wallet, loyalty wallet, historical transactions, personal information (e.g. home address, birthdate, medical history), etc.   Creation, management and storage of digital identities is the key to providing said services, and therefore it is essential that Yassir will rely on its own identity stack and solutions, rather than relying on 3rd party providers. Provisioning of on-demand services, payments, banking and financial services - all require accurate and secured representation of people, businesses and organizations, which is done through an IDP that is designed to the specificities of our region and users.Becoming a leading Identity provider will especially enable the expansion and domination of our neo-bank offerings. 

Central Authentication

Central authentication is at the heart of digital identity services and it could be part of a future IDP platform.Central authentication allows end-users to access multiple applications while providing their credentials (such as user ID and password) only once. It allows Yassir to build, maintain and evolve one central and unified authentication authority and ensure its security, efficiency and functionality, for 1st party clients, and in the future - also to 3rd parties. 

Authentication Team 

The authentication solutions need to be built and evolved by a dedicated team that will operate independently from the existing teams, to ensure an agnostic solution that can be abstracted and scaled. 

Product Manager Role & Responsibilities

The PM will work alongside the engineering lead to analyze the current state of authentication in the company, including existing authentication systems, components, practices and dependencies. In addition:
Collect and analyze the requirements of a new central authentication solution that will replace existing ones, and the signup/login flows.  
Assess industry standards, protocols and specifications to support the technical implementation, including comparable solutions and off-the-shelf products. 
Lead collaboration initiatives across the company, to ensure alignment on scope, timelines and operating model; and execution thereof. 
Define and monitor performance, KPIs and health metrics. 
Develop a digital identity vision and strategy that goes beyond central authentication.  
Manage the day-to-day routines, including agile ceremonies, backlog management, project and program management, OKRs, etc. 

Requirements :

- At least 6 years of experience and min 3 years in Product Management
- Technical background and demonstrated experience preferred as the topic is very technical.
- Business acumen to define the long-term vision for identity and authentication.

lists.content:
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Personal Banking experience — our consumer wallet and the financial products that sit inside the Yassir super app. This is a B2C role at the centre of our financial services strategy.

 

Your core mandate is adoption: getting millions of Yassir users to fund, hold, and transact with the wallet — first inside the super app (rides, deliveries, top-ups), and then beyond it (peer-to-peer transfers, bill payments, merchant payments in the real world). You will own the full consumer journey from first wallet activation to habitual, everyday use.

 

You will work across engineering, design, growth, and the wider super app teams to make the wallet the default way Yassir users move money — turning an existing, trusted user base into active financial services customers.

• Own the personal banking / consumer wallet product end-to-end, with adoption and active usage as your primary success metrics.
  • Define and execute the strategy to drive wallet activation, funding, and repeat transactions — both within the super app (rides, deliveries) and in external use cases (P2P, bill payments, merchant payments).
  • Design acquisition and activation funnels in partnership with growth and marketing; identify and remove the friction points that stop users from funding and using the wallet.
  • Deeply understand the Algerian consumer — cash habits, trust barriers, and the behavioural shifts required to move people from cash to digital money.
  • Run discovery: customer interviews, journey mapping, prototyping, and experiments to validate what will actually drive adoption at scale.
  • Translate customer insights into a prioritised roadmap of features and experiments, tested with real users in market.
  • Partner with engineering and design to ship high-quality consumer experiences — onboarding, KYC, top-up, send/receive, and transaction history — that feel effortless and trustworthy.
  • Leverage Yassir’s existing super app surfaces (ride-hailing, delivery, agent network) as distribution channels for wallet adoption.
  • Instrument the product with analytics; use funnel data, cohort retention, and transaction behaviour to make evidence-based decisions.
  • Synthesise business, market, and customer needs into strategic, evidence-based recommendations for leadership.
  • Facilitate agile ceremonies and keep the squad delivering against roadmap and quality goals.

• Minimum 5 years of product management experience, with a strong track record in B2C fintech, digital banking, wallets, or payments.
  • Proven experience driving consumer adoption and engagement of a financial product — you have moved activation, retention, or transaction metrics, not just shipped features.
  • A track record of launching and scaling consumer-facing digital products (B2C).
  • Strong grasp of acquisition, activation, retention, referral, and revenue — and how to design a product that grows across that funnel.
  • Experience with growth mechanics: onboarding optimisation, funnel analysis, experimentation, and retention loops.
  • Understanding of the technical aspects of digital product development, with the ability to work closely with engineers and get the best out of them.

About the Role:
 
We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Quality Assurance Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the quality and stability of our applications within the financial services domain across Android and iOS platforms. You will be responsible for the end-to-end testing lifecycle—from reviewing requirements and designing comprehensive test plans to executing automated and manual test cases. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve issues, advocate for best practices, and continuously enhance our testing strategies. If you are passionate about automation, skilled in tools like Postman and Xray, and thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments like ours, we would love to have you on board.



Responsibilities:
Review requirements, specifications, and technical documents to provide feedback; analyze test
results to ensure software meets quality standards
Create, execute, and manage test cases (both manual and automated), including detailed plans
for comprehensive coverage
Document testing phases, report bugs, and track defects efficiently. Perform thorough
regression testing to verify bug fixes
Work with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle to maintain
quality and troubleshoot issues
Conduct post-release/post-implementation testing to ensure product stability and quality in
real-world usage
Design and develop automation scripts using open source tools. Stay updated with new testing
tools and strategies to enhance efficiency
Estimate, prioritize, and coordinate testing activities to align with project timelines and objectives
Liaise with internal teams to understand system requirements and monitor the debugging process to ensure effective resolution of issues
Requirements:
at least 4  years of hands-on experience with automated mobile testing on Android and iOS platforms
Hands-on experience in developing automated test cases in at least one programming language
Proven working experience with Agile project management, QA methodology, and testing management software
Hands-on experience with API Testing frameworks such as Postman
Hands-on experience with test management tools such as Xray
Ability to design and write test cases in BDD format
Experience in Smoke Testing, Sanity Testing, Performance Testing, and end-to-end application testing
Hands-on experience with the Robot framework is a plus
Experience in a rapidly growing company in the mobility, on-demand, or fintech space is a plus
BSc/MSc in Engineering, Computer Science, or relevant field

lists.content:

  • Availability: Flexible schedule, including weekends and evenings if needed.

lists.content: • We are looking for a System Security Engineer to strengthen our infrastructure security and ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Yassir’s systems and data. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and maintaining security controls across our cloud and on-premise environments.

• Design, implement, and maintain security solutions for systems, networks, and applications.
  • Monitor systems for potential vulnerabilities, threats, and incidents.
  • Conduct regular security assessments, penetration tests, and audits.
  • Implement and manage Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies.
  • Collaborate with DevOps, Engineering, and IT teams to integrate security best practices into all phases of the development lifecycle.
  • Develop and maintain incident response procedures and ensure quick remediation of security events.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant standards and regulations (ISO 27001, GDPR, etc.).
  • Prepare regular reports on system security status, risks, and recommendations.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
  • Proven experience (3–5+ years) as a System Security Engineer, Security Analyst, or similar role.
  • Strong knowledge of system and network security, intrusion detection/prevention, and vulnerability management.
  • Hands-on experience with firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM, endpoint security, and encryption technologies.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure) and container security (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Bash, etc.) for automation.
  • Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, CEH, CompTIA Security+, etc.) are a plus.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to continuous improvement.

descriptionPlain:
YASSIR est la première Super App en Afrique du Nord, à la croisée de la mobilité, des services financiers et du e-commerce.
Présente dans plus de 45 villes et en pleine expansion internationale, notre mission est de rendre la technologie accessible à tous et de simplifier le quotidien de millions d’utilisateurs.
Dans le cadre de notre forte croissance, nous recherchons un(e) Talent Acquisition Specialist pour rejoindre notre équipe People & Culture à Alger.

lists.content: • Au sein de l’équipe recrutement, vous jouerez un rôle stratégique dans la construction et l’expansion de nos équipes. En collaboration étroite avec les hiring managers, vous serez responsable du cycle complet de recrutement pour des profils variés, principalement dans les domaines Tech, Data, Product Design et Développement.

• Piloter l’ensemble du processus de recrutement, depuis la définition du besoin jusqu’à la signature du contrat.
  • Collaborer avec les managers pour comprendre leurs enjeux et anticiper les besoins futurs.
  • Déployer des stratégies de sourcing innovantes et ciblées afin d’identifier les meilleurs talents du marché.
  • Conduire des entretiens structurés et assurer une expérience candidat de qualité, alignée sur les valeurs de Yassir.
  • Contribuer activement à la stratégie de marque employeur, notamment via les réseaux sociaux et les événements RH.
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus et outils de recrutement.

• Diplôme Bac+3 ou plus en Ressources Humaines, Management ou domaine équivalent.
  • Expérience confirmée (minimum 3 ans) en recrutement, idéalement dans un environnement technologique ou international.
  • Excellente maîtrise des techniques d’entretien et des outils de sourcing.
  • Solides compétences en communication, capacité à influencer et à collaborer avec différents interlocuteurs.
  • Proactivité, sens du résultat et autonomie.
  • Maîtrise du français, avec un bon niveau d’anglais.

• Intégrer un environnement dynamique, multiculturel et en constante évolution.
  • Travailler sur des projets à fort impact dans des domaines innovants (Tech, Data, Produit).
  • Évoluer au sein d’une équipe passionnée, exigeante et bienveillante.
  • Bénéficier d’un cadre propice au développement professionnel et personnel.

lists.content:
We are looking for a Technical Product Manager to join our Core Payments squad, working alongside our Senior PM to build and scale the engine that moves money across the Yassir platform. This is a hands-on, technical role at the heart of our financial infrastructure.

 

Core Payments owns the systems every transaction depends on: the payment orchestration flow, the switch and PSP integrations, and reconciliation and settlement. Every payment on the platform — wallet-to-wallet, card, bill payment, interbank transfer — passes through the sequence of compliance, limit, balance, and ledger checks that this squad is responsible for. Correctness, resilience, and traceability are non-negotiable.

 

You will translate complex payment and ledger requirements into clear specs, work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers on the design of transaction flows, and own the edge cases — retries, failures, reversals, and reconciliation — that make the difference between a payment system that works and one that loses money.

A flavour of the problems this squad solves day to day:

 

  • Payment orchestration — the ordered sequence of checks (channel policy, entitlement, limits, balance, fees, sanctions, fraud, ledger post) that every transaction runs through before money moves.
  • Transaction routing across paths: internal wallet-to-wallet ledger posts, interbank transfers via the national switch, card payments via the scheme, and biller / bill-payment flows.
  • Failure handling and money safety — idempotent retries, suspense accounts, and preventing “ghost” payments where an external party is paid but the customer is never debited (or vice versa).
  • Switch and PSP integration — working with engineers on card authorisation flows, PSP failover, and the messaging between Yassir and external payment networks.
  • Reconciliation and settlement — making sure Yassir’s ledger matches the external world (billers, banks, schemes) and that breaks are surfaced and resolved.
  • Resilience — defining fallback behaviour when a downstream service is slow or down, so the payment path degrades safely instead of failing entirely.

• Own a defined area of the Core Payments roadmap, working closely with the Senior PM and engineering leads on your squad.
  • Write clear, thorough technical specifications — API contracts, transaction flows, state transitions, error codes, and acceptance criteria — that engineers can build from without ambiguity.
  • Reason rigorously about edge cases: what happens on a timeout, a retry, a partial failure, a crash mid-transaction — and specify the correct behaviour for each.
  • Collaborate daily with engineers on system design; understand the tradeoffs well enough to challenge and be challenged, not just relay requirements.
  • Coordinate with adjacent squads — Compliance, Core Banking, and the channel teams — whose systems connect into the payment flow.
  • Partner with operations and finance on reconciliation, settlement, and how payment issues are detected and resolved in production.
  • Use data to monitor payment success rates, latency, and failure modes, and to prioritise what to fix or build next.
  • Facilitate agile ceremonies and keep your squad delivering to roadmap and quality goals.

• 3–5 years of product management experience, with meaningful time on technical or infrastructure products (payments, fintech, ledger, banking, or a comparable backend / platform domain).
  • Genuine technical depth: comfortable with APIs, data models, and system design discussions; able to read a spec, follow a transaction through multiple systems, and spot the gaps.
  • Strong grasp of how payments or financial transactions work end-to-end — authorisation, settlement, reconciliation, and the failure modes in between (or the ability to demonstrate you can learn this fast, backed by adjacent experience).
  • A track record of writing high-quality technical specs and working closely with engineering teams to ship reliable systems.
  • Precision and rigour — you care about correctness, edge cases, and getting the details right, because in payments the details are the product.
  • Ability to work with ambiguity and build in a fast-moving, from-scratch environment.
  • Knowledge of modern development practices like agile and scrum.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to make complex technical topics clear to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Based in Cairo, Egypt (required).
  • Fluent English and Arabic; French is an advantage.

• Direct experience with payment systems: card schemes (ISO 8583), interbank messaging (ISO 20022), switches, PSPs, or gateway integrations.
  • Understanding of double-entry ledgers, suspense accounts, and reconciliation.
  • Experience with idempotency, distributed-system failure handling, or transaction integrity patterns.
  • Exposure to compliance-adjacent product work — limits, sanctions screening, AML, or fraud.
  • A technical, engineering, or consulting background before product.

  • Identify, monitor, and mitigate risks, dependencies, and technical challenges to ensure project success.
  • Bridge the gap between technical teams and stakeholders, translating business requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Implement and enforce agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) and other project management procedures to optimize workflow efficiency.
  • Monitor project progress, track key metrics, and ensure timely delivery of milestones.
  • Oversee technical documentation, system requirements, and quality assurance processes.
  • Ensure compliance with security policies, data governance, and industry best practices, both regionally and internationally.
  • Foster collaboration, communication, and problem-solving among team members and stakeholders.

• Define and document project scope, objectives, and success criteria.
  • Manage and prioritize technology-driven projects, ensuring on-time delivery with high quality.
  • Coordinate with development teams to facilitate smooth software deployment and integration.
  • Conduct thorough risk assessments and develop effective mitigation strategies.
  • Track and report project progress, milestones, and KPIs.
  • Communicate project updates and potential blockers to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Ensure technical teams adhere to best practices, coding standards, and architectural guidelines.
  • Utilize Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies for efficient project execution.
  • Track and optimize project costs, timelines, and resource utilization.
  • Support post-implementation reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with vendors and external partners on technology implementations.
  • Implement best practices in project management, DevOps, and software development.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in technical project management, software development, IT project delivery, or technical leadership.
  • Strong expertise in software development, cloud platforms, DevOps, and IT infrastructure.
  • Deep understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), databases, and system architecture.
  • Experience with cloud computing (GCP, AWS, Azure).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, microservices, and API integration.
  • Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and project management tools (e.g., JIRA).
  • Previous experience with risk management, technical leadership, and quality assurance.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills for interacting with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • High adaptability and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Other key skills and traits:
  • Outstanding written & verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize, self-start, contribute under pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Highly organized, creative, and a critical thinker.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment.
  • Organized and obsessive about details.
  • Hard-working, passionate, and looking to embrace the challenge.

• Great compensation and bonuses, including stock options.
  • Ground-floor opportunity to shape the strategic direction of the company.
  • Sharp, motivated co-workers in a fun office environment or remote.
  • Paid company holidays.
  • Full social coverage.

• Join one of the fastest-growing tech companies in North Africa.
  • Have a lasting impact on our company's culture and growth.
  • Make a real impact on the world by helping us bring affordable financial and on-demand services to millions of Africans.
  • Work on truly challenging technical projects—from identity infrastructure for Africans, digital payment networks, to complex mapping and routing systems across the continent.
  • We’re the first Algerian startup to go through Y Combinator and are backed by top investors including Unpopular Ventures, Rebel Fund, and DainTree.VC.
